vya_text: dI0- idAnImatIsArAdInAM rogANAM BedAn darSayannAha - pRuthagiti | atIva saratItyatIsAro gudena | sa ca sapta prakAro Bavati | tadyathA pRuthagdoShairityAdi | pRuthagdoShairityanena vAtena pittena kaPena trayaH, sarvairiti militadoShatrayeNaikaH, SokAditi iShTAdiviyoganimittAt, AmAdaparipakvarasAt, AmAjIrNAdvA, ajIrNamapakvaM ca varShAdinA, BayAdBIteH | nanu mAdhavena ShaDvidhotIsAro,nigadito yathA - `ekaikaSaH sarvaSaScApi doShaiH SokenAnyaH ShaShTha Amena coktaH' iti tat kathamatra saptavidha iti ?, ucyate, nidAnaM tu niyatAniyataBedena dvividhaM SokAjIrNAdiByo~api kadAcidatIsAra utpadyate | BayanidAnenApyAvaSyakamatIsAro BavatItyadoShaH | yato dRuSyate hi saBayapuruShasya tatkShaNameva dravasaraNaM gudeneti | tasmAdatra niyatahetuko nAma saptamo BayAt pratipAdita ityarthaH | iti saptadhA pratipAditaH | grahaNI pa~jcadhA matetyAdi | grahaNI vahnisthAnaM tadASrito doSha eva saMgrahaNISabdavAcyaH| kutracidgrahaNIdoSha ityupadarSanAt, taduktam - `ShaShThI pittadharA nAma yA kalA parikIrtitA | pakvAmASayamadhyasthA grahaNI sA prakIrtitA' iti | grahaNAdgrahaNI matetyapi | yataH - `agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAdgrahaNI matA' iti | pa~jcadhA pa~jcaprakArA | tathA cAmena pa~jcamIti | Amena AmavAtenetyarthaH | pravAhikA caturdhA syAdityAdi | saSabdaM kaNThabalena vAyorapAnamArgeNa bahirniHsaraNaM pravAhikA | asyAH paryAyanAmAni tantrAntarapratipAditAni | yathA kecana visraMsIti#foot@-‘vivaSI’ iti ‘ka’ pustake # nAmnA kathayanti, eke cAntargranthiriti, ke~api niScAraM, nivAhikAmityapare | caturdheti | vAtapittakaPai raktajaSca | asraM rudhiram | nanu pravAhikA~atIsArayoH ko BedaH yasmAddravasaraNatvenA- pakvalakShaNayogAtsAdharmyaM tat kathaM BedaH ? ucyate - nAnAdravadhAtusaraNamatIsAraH | pravAhikAyAM tu kevalaM kaPasaraNamayamatra BedaH || 7 || 8 ||

gU0 – athAtisArasaMKyAmAha - pRuthak tridoShaiH vAtapittakaPaiH trayaH, sarvaiH triBirmilitvA ekaH, ekaH SokAt, ekaH AmAt, evaM saptadhAsAraH | nanu suSrutAdau ShaDvidho~atIsAraH paThitaH tatkathaM na virodhaH tathAcoktaM `saratyatIvAtisAraM tamAhurvyAdhi GoraM ShaDvidhaM taM vadanti | Bayajasya suSrute vAtikAtIsArAvaruddhatvAt ShaDvidhaH carakamate Bayajasya liKitatvAt, atra saptavidhaH kRutaH ato na doShaH | atIva saratItyatIsAra iti niruktiSca || grahaNIsaMKyAmAha - pRuthagdoShairvAtapittakaPaistisraH, nnipAtAdekA, Amena pa~jcamI, evaM pa~jcadhA nidAne grahaNI caturdhA liKitA AmajAyA aBAvAt | pravAhikAmAha - pRuthagdoShaiH vAtapittakaPaistisrastataH sannipAtAccaturthI, evaM caturdhA pravAhaNAtpravAhikAti sAraBedaH || 7 || 8 ||

vya_text: dI0 – athAjIrNAnyAha - ajIrNamiti | ajIrNaM trividhaM proktamiti ajIrNamityaparipakvAnnajanitaM trividhamiti vAtAdiBedena eke ajIrNaM vividhaM proktamityapi paThanti | tanmataM tu mAdhavenoktaM yathA - `AmaM vidagdhaM viShTabdhaM kaPapittAnilaistriBiH | ajIrNaM kecidicCanti caturthaM rasaSeShata: || ajIrNaM pa~jcamaM kecinnirdoShaM dinapAki ca | vadanti ShaShThaM cAjIrNaM prAkRutaM prativAsaram' iti | yadrasAdekamajIrNaM tadviShAjIrNamatra pratipAditaM viShavanmAraNAtmakatvAt, rogasa~gkarakaramityanye | nanu AmAjIrNAdiByo rasaSeShasya ko BedaH ? ucyate-AmAditrayamannajaM rasaSeShastu AhArarasajaH | `doShaiH syAdalasastridhA' iti | doShairvAtAdiBiralasaka iti viShTabdhAjIrNAdBavati tasya doShasthiratvanimittAdalasakasaMj~jA | yaduktaM - `prayAti nordhvaM nAdhastAdAhAro na vipacyate| koShThe sthito~alasIBUtastena cAlasakaH smRutaH' iti | nanu viShTabdhAjIrNAdalasakotpattiH viShTabdhastu vAtenaiva saMBavati | yaduktaM - `ajIrNamAmaM viShTabdhaM vidagdhaM ca yadIritam | visUcyalasakau tasmAdBaveccApi vilambikA' iti | kathamalasako vAtAdiBistriBirdoShaiH syAt ? naiSha doShaH - doShakArye doShAntaraprakopa eva yathA sAmAnyajvaraprakopAt SvAsAdyupadravAH, athavA - `ekaH prakupito doShaH sarvANyeva prakopayet' ityAdivacanAt | visUcI trividhA prokteti | doShairvAtapittakaPaiH pRuthakpRuthagiti vyastAnAM doShANAM trayo BedA ityaBiprAyaH | sA visUcI tu AmAjIrNAdBavati | viSeSheNa sUcIBiriva marmANi pIDayatIti visUcI, taduktam - `sUcIBiriva gAtrANi tudan santiShThate~anilaH | yasyAjIrNena sA vaidyairvisUcIti nigadyate' iti | evaM daNDakAlasakamiti | taccAlasakaBedaBinnalakShaNatvena pRuthagdarSitam | tadyathA - `tiryaggatAstanuM doShA daNDavat stamBayanti ye | sa daNDAlasakastyAjyaH SIGraM dehavinASakRut' iti | vilambikApyekA sAvidagdhAjIrNapraBavA kathitA iyamapi tridoShajanitetyuktatvAt | yathA `duShTaM tu BuktaM kaPamArutAByAM pravartate nordhvamadhaSca yasyAm | vilambikAM tAM BRuSaduScikitsyAmAcakShate SAstravidaH purANAH' iti | nanu vilambikAlasakayorapi vAtakaPaprabalayorUrdhvAdhopravartanaSIlayostulyatvAt ko BedaH ? ucyate, alasake tIvrAH SUlAdayo Bavanti, vilambikAyAM na BavantIti BedaH || 9-11 ||

`arSAMsi Kalu jAyante na sannipatitaistriBiH | doShairdoShaviSeShastu viSeShaH kathyate~arSasAm' iti | dvandvajAnAmatraikaBedo jAtyaikavacanatvAt | teShAM Bedo dvidhA mata iti | teShAM ShaDvidhAnAM dvidheti sahajottarajanmaByAM sUcitaH, saha SarIreNa jAtAni gudavalyAramBakavIryaBAgasya doShadUShitatvAt kulajAnAmityarthaH | uttarajanmeti janmottarasaMbandhInyarSAMsi mithyA~ahAravihArAByAmudgatairdoSharBavantItyuttarajanmAnItyarthaH | mAdhavena tu sahajArSaH ShaDvidhasaMKyAyAM paThitameva, tadAha - `pRuthagdoShaiH samastaistu SoNitAt sahajAni ca | arSAMsi ShaTprakArANi vidyAdgudavalitraye' iti | sahajArSato BinnalakShaNoktatvAt prasa~ggato~api sahajArSasAM lakShaNAnyAha suSrutaH - `durdarSanAni paruShANi pANDUni dAruNAnyantarmuKAni ca tairupadrutaH kRuSo~alpaBuk SirAsantatagAtro~alpaprajaH kShINaretAH kShAmasvaraH krodhako~alpAgnirGrANaSiro~akShiSravaNarogI satatamantrakUjATopahRudayopalepAsekaprasRutiBiH pIDyate' iti sahajAnAM lakShaNam | SeShANi tUttarajanmaSabdavAcyAni na kevalaM sahajottarajanyaByAM dvidhA, kintu SuShkArdraBedato dvidhA Bavanti tena tu gudA~gkurA eke SuShkAH srAvarahitA Bavanti atyanilatvAt, eke ArdrAH srAvayuktAH pittaraktAti- prakopatvAt | tridhaiva carmakIlAnIti | gudauShThaM parityajya kIlasadRuSamarSaH kuryAt, tatkIlakamiti tatrA- rSasAmevAsaMBavatvAdasau BedaH | taduktaM - `vyAno gRuhItvA SleShmANaM karotyarSastvaco bahiH | kIlopamaM sthiraKaraM carmakIlaM tu tadviduH' ityatrA~api tvaco bahirityanena gudoShThaM vyajyata iti vyAKyAnayanti | tadgudoShThaM kiyatparimANamiti vivakShAyAM suSrutaH - ardhapa~jcA~ggulaparimANaM gudamiti tasyAvayavaBUtAstisro valaya uparyupari vyavasthitAH Sa~gKAvartaniBAH pravAhaNI visarjanI saMvaraNI ceti | tatra gudoShThaM ardhA~ggulaM sArdhayavam, sArdhaikA~ggulIpramANA prathamAvalI | ditIyA sArdhaikA~ggulA tRutIyA~api sArdhaikA~ggulI evamardhapa~jcA~ggulamiti | Boje~apyuktam-`romAnteByo yavAdardhaM gudoShThaM paricakShate | gudoShThAda~ggulaM caiva prathamAM tAM valiM viduH || sArdhaikA~ggulamAnena anye ca parikIrtite ||' iti || 12-13 ||

gU0 – athArSorogagaNanA - vAtAdeH ShaDvidhAnyarSAMsyAhuH | munaya iti SeSha | vAtAtpittAtkaPAdasraM raktaM tasmAtsannipAtAt saMsargAdvidoShasaMbandhaH tasmAt evaM ShaT | nanu suSrute tu ShaT saMsargajAni proktAni BinnAnyeva prakRutisamavetatvAt pRuthag noktAni | tathAcoktaM suSrute - `arSaHsu dRuSyate rUpaM yadA vai doShayordvayoH | saMsargatvaM vijAnIyAtsaMsargaH ShaDvidhaSca sa' iti | ucyate - atra saMsargajAni madhye gaNitAni sarujAni janmottarANi SuShkArdrANi ca carmakIlaM ca etAnyarSoBedAni BinnAni Bavanti | tAnyAha - sahajottaraM janmAnantaraM tathA SuShkArdraBedataH teShAM Bedastu dvidhA smRutaH kathitaH | dehena sahajAtaM sahajamucyate | uttarajanma uttaraM paScAjjanma yasya taduttarajanma janmAnantaraM jAtamityarthaH | carmakIlAnyapi tadBedajAtiBinnAni Bavanti tAni vAtAt pittAt kaPAdevaMvidhAni Bavanti | nanvarSaH kimAtmakaM kiMsvarUpaM BavatItyAha - arivat SRuNoti hinastItyarthaH | pRuShodarAditvAnniruktiH | taduktaM vAgBaTe - 'arivatprANino mAMsakIlane niviSaMti yat | arSAMsi tasmAducyante gudamArganirodhataH |' mAdhavanidAne ca - `doShastva~gmAMsamedAMsi saMdUShya vividhAkRutIn | mAMsA~gkurA apAnAdau kurvantyarSAMsi tA~jjaguH' ityarSogaNanA || 12-13 ||

pada: arSAMsi ShaDvidhAnyAhurvAtapittakaPAsrataH | sannipAtAcca saMsargAtteShAM Bedo dvidhA mataH || 12|| sahajottarajanmaByAM tathA SuShkArdraBedataH | tridhaiva carmakIlAni vAtAtpittAtkaPAdapi ||13||

vya_text: dI0 - ekaviMSatiMBedeneti | kRumayastu ekaviMSatiBedena viKyAtAH, te tu bAhyAByAntaraBedena dvidhA Bavanti | teShu yUkA bahiScarA iti | teShu kRumisamUheShu yUkA likShASca bahiScarA bAhyA bahiHSarIre jAtAH | anye avaSiShTAstu antaracarA j~jAtavyA iti SeShaH | antaraM koShTheShu carantIti | te cAShTAdaSaprakArA Bavanti | tadyathA -hRudayodakAdidarBakusumAntAH | saptakaPAditi | kaPaprAyadoShajAH, eteShAM svarUpamapi tantrAntare coktaM -`pRuthubradhnaniBAH kecitkecidgaNDUpadopamAH | rUDhadhAnyA~gkurAkArAstanudIrGAstathA~aNavaH || SvetAstAmrAvaBAsASca nAmataH saptadhA tu te' iti | tathA raktAcceti ShaTkRumayo Bavanti, te ca mAtarapraBRutikeSAdaparyantAH, AkArAdapyete yathA - `raktavAhiSirAsthAnaraktajA jantavo~aNavaH | apAdA vRuttatAmrASca saukShmyAt kecidadarSanA:' ityete ShaDBedAH kuShThaikakArakA vij~jeyAH | tathA~anye pa~jca kRumayaH SakRujjAtA Bavanti, SakRut purIShaM, taduktam - `pakvASaye purIShotthA jAyante~adho visarpiNaH' iti | te tu makerukAdikakerukAntAH pa~jca svarUpato yathA - `pRuthuvRuttatanusthUlA: SyAmapItasitA~asitAH' iti | ityevamekaviMSatikRumayo vyAKyAtAH | nanu mAdhavena viMSatikRumiBedA darSitAH, `nAmato viMSatividhA' ityAdivacanAt, tatkathamatraikaviMSatirnigadyate ? ucyate, mAdhavena tu bAhyagatAH kRumayo dviBedAH kathitAH, tadyathA - `tilapramANasaMsthAnavarNAH keSAmbarASrayAH | bahupAdASca sUkShmASca yUkA liKyASca nAmataH | dvidhA te koThapiDakAkaNDUgaNDAn prakurvate' iti, atra tu viMSatiriti saMj~jAvarNaBedAt sthAnaBedAcca pRutha~gna gaNitA iti na doShaH | anyaH snAyukasaMj~jaH kRumireva sa tu kaParaktAByAM saMjAtaH | nanu yadyevaM tarhi dvAviMSatikRumayaH kathaM na gaNitAH ? satyam - ayamapi kaPajeShu saptasu kRumiShu ye dIrGAsteShAM Beda eva | ata eva kaParaktAByAM saMjAyata ityuktam | yataH, `kaPAdAmASaye jAtA vRuddhAH sarpanti sarvataH' ityAdivacanAt snAyukarUDhitvenA~atra BinnacikitsArthadarSanAcca pRuthak gaNita iti na doShaH. || 14-18 ||

gU0 - atha kRumigaNanAmAha - bAhyAByantaraBedataH dvAviMSatiprakAreNa uktAH kRumayaH dvidhA Bavanti | te bAhyA dvau, AByantarAH pa~jca | tathAnyaH kaParaktAByAM saMjAtaH snAyukaH anye vraNakRumayaH, etau dvau Bedau evaM dvAviMSatiH | nanu suSrute tu kRumayo viMSatividhA uktAH | tathAca suSrute - `kRumayastu dvidhA proktA bAhyAByantaraBedataH | vahnirmalakaPAsRugviDjanmaBedAccaturvidhAH | nAmato viMSatividhA bAhyAstatra malodBavAH' iti kathaM atra dvAviMSati: ? ucyate, kRumayastu viMSatividhA eva | atha ca snAyukaiH vraNakRumiBirmilitvA dvAviMSatiH, te suSrutAdau BinnA uktAH ato na doShaH | kRumijanito rogaH kRumiroga iti niruktiH tathAca kRumijAtalakShaNam || 14-18 ||

pada: evaM viMSatiBedena kRumayaH syurdvidhA ca te | bAhyAstathAByantarAH syusteShu yUkA bahiScarAH ||14|| likShAScAnye~antaracarAH kaPAtte hRudayodakAH | antrAdA udarAveShTAScyuravaSca mahAguhAH || 15 || sugandhA darBakusumAstathA raktASca mAtaraH | saurasA lomavidhvaMsA romadvIpA udumbarAH || 16|| keSAdASca tathaivAnye SakRujjAtA makerukA: | lelihASca salUnASca sausurAdAH kakerukAH || 17 || tathAnyaH kaParaktAByAM saMjAtaH snAyukaH smRutaH | vraNasya kRumayaScAnye viShamA bAhyayonayaH || 18||

vya_text: dI0 - pANDurogASceti | pANDurvarNatvenopalakShito rogaH pANDuroga iti rUDhiH | pa~jca syuriti pa~jcaprakArA BavantItyarthaH | te ke vAtapittakaPaiH kRutvA vyastAstrayo BedAH, tridoShairiti militadoShatrayeNaiko BedaH | mRutti- kABiriti mRudBakShaNAdekaH, evaM pa~jca prakArAH pANDurogaBedA boddhavyAH | mRuttikABiriti bahuvacanatvena bahavo mRuttikAdoShaprakopaviSeSheNa darSitAH, tathAhi - `mRuttikAdanaSIlasya kupyatyanyatamo malaH | kaShAyA mArutaM pittamUSharA madhurA kaPam | kopayenmRudrasAdIMSca raukShyAdBuktaM ca raukShayet' iti | prasa~ggato~api tatsvarUpaM suSrutoktamAha - `yA pItavarNA madhurA kaShAyA kRuShNA madhukShAraguNopapannA | raktA ca tiktA kaTukA ca nIlA sitA ca mAdhuryaguNA sahA syAt' ityuktatvAt| tathaikA kAmalA matetyupekShitAtpANDurogata eva kAmalA Bavati | taduktam -`pANDurogI ca yo~atyarthaM pittalAni niShevate | tasya pittamasRu~gmAMsaM dagdhvA rogAya kalpate' iti | rogAya kAmalAsvarUpAyetyaBiprAyaH | tasmAt kumBakAmalA caiketi kumBakAmalA~apyekA Bavati | kAmalAyA avasthAntaraM kumBakAmaletyucyate, yataH - `kAlAntarAt KarIBUtA kRucCrA syAt kumBakAmalA' ityAdivacanAt | ekaM halImakamiti tadapi pANDurogAvasthAyAmeva Bavati | taduktam - `yadA tu pANDorvarNaH syAddharitaH SyAvapItakaH | halImakaM tadA tasya vidyAdanilapittataH' iti || 19 ||

gU0 - atha pANDukAmalAhalImakasaMKyAmAha - vAtapittakaPaistridoShairmRuttikABiSca evaM pANDurogAH pa~jca syu: BaveyuH | pANDutvacopalakShitA rogAH pANDurogA iti niruktiH | kAmalA ekA ekaprakArA sA pittajanyA, kumBakAmalA ca ekaprakArA pittajanyA | halImakaM ca ekaM ekaprakAraM tat anilapittataH, ete rogAH pANDuBedAH || 19 ||

pada: pANDurogASca pa~jca syurvAtapittakaPaistridhA | tridoShairmRuttikABiSca tathaikA kAmalA smRutA ||19|| syAtkumBakAmalA caikA tathaikaM ca halImakam |

vya_text: dI0 - raktapittamiti | raktaM ca pittaM ceti suSrutaH | carake tu rAgaprAptaM pittaM raktapittamityucyate | yaduktaM `raktasya pittamAKyAtaM raktapittaM manIShiBiH' iti | uBayatrApi na kaSciddoShaH | Urdhvagamiti nAsAsyakarNAkShirandhreShu | adhogamiti meDhrayonigudamArgeShu | taddvayena dvimArgamiti | taddvayena kaPavAtAByAM, dvimArgagamityUrdhvAdhaHpravartanAt | eke taddvayena vimArgagamiti paThanti tatra romakUpeShvapi tat pravartata iti vyAKyAnayanti | taduktam - `kupitaM romakUpeShu samastaistatpravartate' iti || 20 ||

gU0- atha raktapittasaMKyA - UrdhvAdhaH muKanAsAgudadrAvi pravRuttaM raktaM raktapittamucyate | tattrividhaM, UrdhvagaM kaPajaM, adhogaM mArutAnugaM, vAtena janitaM dvimArgagaM, dvayena kaPavAtenetyarthaH || 20 ||

pada: raktapittaM tridhA proktamUrdhvagaM kaPasaMBavam ||20|| adhogaM mArutaM j~jeyaM taddvayena dvimArgagam |

vya_text: dI0 - kAsA iti | kasanaM kAsaH | `BinnasvaraH kAsati SuShkameva' iti suSrutavacanAt | tathAhi - `prANo hyudAnAnugataH praduShTaH saMBinnakAMsyasvanatulyaGoShaH | nireti vakrAt sahasA sa doSho manIShiBiH kAsa iti pradiShTaH' iti | pa~jceti pa~jca prakArAH te ke prakArA ityata Aha - te trayastu triBirmalairiti | te kAsAH triBirmalaistriBirdoShaistraya eva kathitAH | uraHkShatAccaturthaH syAditi urasi prahAramiva vedanAviSeShAduraHkShatakAsasaMj~jAH, tathAhyuktam - `ativyavAyamallAdhvayuddhASvagajanigrahaiH | rUkShasyoraHkShataM vAyugRuhItvA kAsamAvahet | sa pUrvaM kAsate SuShkaM tataH ShThIvet saSoNitam | kaNThena rujatA~atyarthaM viBinnenaiva corasA' iti | kShayAddhAtoSca pa~jcama iti | dhAtavo rasAdyAH, teShA kShayAnnASAt | eke dhAtorityekavacanatvena SukrakShayAditi vyAKyAnayanti, tatra pratilomAnulomena dhAtukShaya ukta iti na doShaH | taduktam - `ativyavAyino vApi kShINe retasyanantarAH | kShIyante dhAtavaH sarve tataH SuShyati mAnavaH' ityAdidarSanAt || 21 ||

gU0- atha kAsasaMKyA - samuddiShTAH kAsAH pa~jcaviMSatistAnAha - kAsA iti| triBirmalairdoShaistrayaH, uraHkShatAccaturthaH, dhAto rasAdidhAtoH kShayAtpa~jcamaH evaM pa~jca kAsAH | kasanaM kAsa iti nirukti: | kasa gatiSAsanayoriti dhAtvarthAt athavA BagnakAMsyapAtrasvana: kAsa iti || 21 ||

pada: kAsAH pa~jca samuddiShTAste trayastu triBirmalaiH ||21|| uraHkShatA~jcaturthaH syAtkShayAddhAtoSca pa~jcamaH |

vya_text: dI0- kShayA iti | upekShitakAsAt kShayo BavatIti | eke `kAsAt saMjAyate kShayaH' ityuktatvAt kadAcit kShayatvena tu niyatameva | kShayo~api rAjayakShmasaMj~jaH kathyate | taduktaM - `rAj~jaScandramaso yasmAdaBUdeShaH kilAmayaH | tasmAttaM rAjayakShmeti kecidAhurmanIShiNaH' iti | pa~jcamaH syAduraHkShatAditi | uraHkShato rogaviSeShaH sarvatra pratipAditatvAt | SoShA: syu: ShaTprakAreNeti `SoSho~api kShayaBedaH syA'diti vacanAt | yataH `SoShaNAcca rasAdInAM SoSha ityucyate budhaiH| kriyAkShayakaratvAcca kShaya ityaBidhIyate' iti | ShaTprakArA yathA - strIprasa~ggAdIti | strIniShevaNAt | ayaM vyavAyaSoShI kathitaH | SucaH SokAt, ayaM SokaSoShI | vraNAditi SarIrA~agantuvraNaviSeShAt | yataH `raktakShayAdvedanABistathaivAhArayantraNAt | vraNinaSca BavecCoShaH sa cAsAdhyatamo mataH' | adhvaSramAditi | atimArgagamanajanitaSramAcca ayamadhvaSoShI | vyAyAmAditi SarIrAyAsajananakarmasvarUpAt | nanu vyAyAmAdhvaSramayorAyAsajananasAdharmyAt ko BedaH ? ucyate, vyAyAmo yadAkasmAdevA~atikriyate tadaiva Bavati | mArgagamanaSIlatvAdevAdhvaSoShaH syAt | taduktam `adhvaSoShI ca srastA~ggaH saMmRuShTaparuShacCaviH' ityadoShaH | vArdhakyAditi jarABivyAptaSarIratvAt, ayaM jarASoShI kathitaH | taduktam - `jarASoShI kRuSo mandavIrya- buddhibalendriyaH' ityAdi || 92 || 23 ||

gU0- atha kShayasaMKyAmAha - nanu suSrute tridoSheNa eka eva kShayaH proktaH tatkatham ? tathAcoktaM `tridoSho jAyate yakShmagade eva catuShTayAt'| ucyate udrekAtpa~jcavidhatvam | tathAcoktaM suSrute `eka eva mataH SoShaH sannipAtAtmako gadaH | udrekAttasya li~ggAni doShANAM nipatanti hi' iti, ato na doShaH | kShIyate aneneti kShaya iti tasya niruktiH, tathAcoktaM saMSoShaNAditi SoSha ityaBidhIyate kriyAkShayakAritvAt kShaya ityucyate budhaiH | rAjayakShmA SoShaSca tadBedau | yakShmaNAM rAjA rAjayakShmA yadvA candramaso jAtatvAt rAjayakShmeti niruktiH | SoShamAha - SoShAH ShaT prakArAH syuH strIprasaMgAdekaH, vraNAdekaH, adhvA mArgastacCramastasmAdekaH, vyAyAmo BallAdiyuddhaM tasmAdekaH, vRuddhaBAvAdekaH, evaM ShaT SoShAH | rasAdiSoShaNAt SoShAH pa~jca kShayAH ShaT SoShAH evaM kovidA ekAdaSA AhuH || 22|| 23 ||

pada: kShayAH pa~jcaiva vij~jeyAstriBirdoShaistrayaSca te || 22 || caturthaH sannipAtena pa~jcamaH syAduraHkShatAt | SoShA: syu: ShaTprakAreNa strIprasa~ggAcCuco vraNAt || 23 || adhvaSramAcca vyAyAmAdvArdhakyAdapi jAyate |

vya_text: dI0 - SvAsASceti | SvAsa iti vegavadUrdhvavAtatvam | yataH `SvAsaSca bastikAdhmAnaM samavAtordhvagAmitA' iti | pa~jceti pa~jcaprakArAH, te ke prakArA ityAha - kShudra ityAdi | duHKenA~ggaprabAdhako~alpavAtajanitaH kShudraSvAsasaMj~jaH | pratilomena vAyunA grIvAM SiraSca saMgRuhya tIvravegaM karoti sa ca tamasi nimagna iva tiShThati tena tamakaSvAsa iti saMj~jaH | yo dIrGaM Svasiti UrdhvadRuShTiM ca karoti itastato viBrAntanetra: sa UrdhvaSvAsArditaH kathitaH | yaH SabdavAn duHKitaH uccaiH Svasiti pranaShTaj~jAnavij~jAno viSIrNavAk sa mahASvAsapIDito~aBihitaH | yo vicCinnaM Svasiti sarvaprANena pIDita AnAhasvedamUrcCArtaH sa CinnaSvAsArdita iti || 24 ||
gU0 – SvAsasaMKyAmAha

pada: SvAsASca pa~jca vij~jeyAH kShudraH syAttamakastathA || 24 || UrdhvaSvAso mahASvAsaSCinnaSvAsaSca pa~jcamaH |

vya_text: dI0- hikkAmAha - kathitA iti | tvaritaM prANaharatvena hikkA kathitAH | taduktam - `kAmaM prANaharA rogA bahavo na tu te tathA | yathA SvAsaSca hikkA ca harataH prANamASu ca' iti | hikkAsvarUpaM tu GoShavattvena pratipAditaM | yataH - `muhurmRuhurvAyurudeti sasvano yakRutplIhAntrANi muKAdivAkShipan | sa GoShavAnASu hinasti yasmAt tatastu hikketyaBidhIyate budhaiH' iti| pa~jceti pa~jcaprakArA:, tAn prakArAn Aha - kShudreti | yA mandavegaiH - kRutvA jatrumUlAdeva pradhAvati sA kShudrA nAma hikkA kathitA | yAmatiprayuktapAnAnnaiH pIDito vAyurUrdhvamAgatya hikkayati tAmannajAM vidyAt | yA GorA gamBIranAdinI nABipraBavA sA gamBIrA j~jeyA | yA cireNa yamalairvegaiH kRutvA pravartate SirogrIvAM ca kampamati sA yamalA nAma kathitA | yA satataM marmANyutpIDayantIva sarvagAtraprakampiNIva sA mahatI nAma hikkA kathitA || 95 ||
gU0- atha hikkAsaMKyA kathiteti sugamam | hinasti prANAniti hikkA || 25 ||

pada: kathitAH pa~jca hikkAstu tAstu kShudrA~annajastathA ||25|| gamBIrA yamalA caiva mahatI pa~jcamI smRutA |

vya_text: dI0- catvAra iti | agniScAtra jaTharAgniH, tajjanito vikAraScAtra kupitadoShavAcyaH | ata eva samAgnigrahaNaM nAtra kRutaM doShasAmyatvAt, yataH `samAgni: SreShTha ucyate' iti vacanAt | ke te catvAra ityAha - viShama ityAdi | yo BuktamannaM kadAcinna pacati kadAcidASveva pacati sa viShamaH yo mAtrA~atimAtramapyannaM suKaM pacati sa tIkShNaH, ya: svalpamapyannaM na pacati sa manda iti) Basmakastu tIvrAgnisaMj~jaH sa ca vAtapittajanitaH | taduktam - `atipravRuddhaH pavanAnvito~agniH kShaNAdrasaM SoShayati prasahya | BuktaM kShaNAdBasma karoti yasmAttasmAdayaM BasmakasaMj~jakastu ? | iti || 26 ||
gU0- athAgnivikArasaMKyA - viShamAdayaScatvAro~agnervikArAH syu: | nanu nidAne samena saha catvAro~agnervikArAH Basmako Binna uktaH tadatra na doShaH samasya vikArABAvAt || 26 ||

pada: catvAro~agnervikArAH syurviShamo vAtasaMBavaH || 26 || tIkShNaH pittAtkaPAnmando Basyako vAtapittayoH |

vya_text: dI0 - pa~jcaiveti | arocakAstu paryAyanAmaBireva tridhA kathitAH, tadyathA satyAmapi buBukShAyAmaByava hArAsAmarthyamatyaruciH, aBilaShitamapyannaM dIyamAnaM nAByavaharatItyanannABinandanam; annasya SravaNasmaraNa- darSanasparSanairyatrodvijate sa BaktadveShaH; evaM trividho~api rogaScarakasuSrutAByAmarocakaSabdena saMgRuhItaH | vRuddhaBojena saMj~jAntarANyapi darSitAni | kAni tAnyAha - `prakShiptaM ca muKe cAnnaM janturna svadate muhu: | arocaka: sa vij~jeyo BaktadveShamatho SRuNu | cintayitvA tu manasA dRuShTvA SrutvA ca Bojanam | dveShamAyAti yo janturBaktadveShaH sa ucyate || yasya nAnne Bavet SraddhA so~aBaktacCanda ucyate | kupitasya BayArtasya yasya Bakta nirodhaja:' || 27 ||

pada: pa~jcaivArocakA j~jeyA vAtapittakaPaistridhA || 27 || sannipAtAnmanastApAt -

vya_text: dI0 – CardimAha -- Cardaya iti | CardirvamanaviSeShaH | vegai: kRutvA AnanaM CAdayatIti CardiH | taduktam - `CAdayannAnanaM vegairardayanna~ggaBa~jjanaiH | nirucyate Cardiriti doSho vakraM pradhAvitaH' iti | kRumiBiriti kRumirogajanitA, tathAcoktam - `SUlahRullAsabahulA kRumijA ca | viSeShataH | kRumihRudrogatulyena lakShaNena ca lakShitA' iti | sannipAtata iti militadoShatrayAt | GRuNayA ceti GRuNayA kRutvA CardirBavatItyaBiprAyaH; GRuNA ca pUtyamedhyAdigandhAsvAdanairutpadyate | GRuNayA ceti cakArAdbIBatsAdyavalokanAcca BavatIti kecit | taduktaM - `bIBatsairhetuBiScAnnairdrutamutkleSito balAt' iti | tathA strINAM garBAdhAnAcca jAyate iti gRuhItagarBAyAH striyaSCardirBavatIti | yataH - `nAryAScApannasattvAyAstathA~atidrutamaSnataH' ityAdivacanAt || 28 ||
gU0- atha CardisaMKyA tAH sapta BavantItyAha - pRuthagdoShairiti sugamam || 28 ||

pada: CardayaH saptadhA matAH | triBirdoShaiH pRuthaktisra kRumiBiH sannipAtataH || 28|| GRuNayA ca tathA strINAM garBAdhAnAcca jAyate |

vya_text: dI0- svaraBedA iti | prakRutirUpasya svarasyAnyathABAvaH svaraBedaH; sa ca ShaDvidho Bavati, vAtAdInAM vyastAstrayo BedAH, sannipAtena militadoShatrayeNa caikaH, medasA medovRuddheScaiko BedaH, kShayAt kShayarogAdekaH, dhAtukShayAdveti kecit || 29 ||
gU0- atha svaraBedAnAha

pada: svaraBedAH ShaDeva syurvAtapittakaPaistrayaH || 29 || medasA sannipAtena kShayAtShaShThaH prakIrtitaH |

vya_text: dI0 - tRuShNeti | tRuShNA pAnIyasyABilAShaH | taduktam - `satataM yaH pibedvAri na tRuptimadhigacCati | punaH kA~gkShati yastoyaM taM tRuShNArditamAdiSet' iti | tridoShairiti melitadauShatrayeNa | upasargaScAgantuka:, sa ca kShatAdiSabdavAcyaH| tena janitA upasargikA | kShayAddhAtoriti rasAdidhAtukShayAt | cakArAt saptamI tu BuktodBavA iti manyante kecit | yaduktaM -`snigdhaM tathoShNaM lavaNaM ca BuktaM gurvannamevASu tRuShAM karoti' | apare tvAmasaMBavAM vadanti| sA doShajAntargateti manyamAnena SAr~ggadhareNa nAtra svIkRutA iti || 30 ||

gU0- tRuShNAmAha - nanu nidAnena sapta tRuShNAH proktAH atra ShaT, tatkathaM taduktaM `doShaiSca tisraH kShatajA caturthI kShayAttathA- nyAmasamudBavA ca | BuktodBavA saptamiketi tAsAM nibodhali~ggAnyanupUrvaSastu | srotaHsvapAMvAhiShu dUShiteShu doShaiSca tRuT saMBavatIha jantoH', iti ? | ucyate AmajAnidAne atra tridoShajA li~ggasamudBavA ca ityuktatvAtsaMsargajAkShatajA caivaM ShaT | BuktodBavA na vikArajA ato noktA || 30 ||

pada: tRuShNA ca ShaDvidhA proktA vAtAtpittAtkaPAdapi || 30 || tridoShairupasargeNa kShayAddhAtoSca ShaShThikA |

vya_text: dI0- mUrcCeti | mUrcCA mohasaMj~jA viKyAtA, yataH `moho mUrcCeti tAmAhuH' ityAdi vacanAt | sA caturvidhA catuHprakArA doShaBedena Bavati | eko BramaH smRuta iti | Bramastu rajaHpittAnilAdBavati sa tu cakrArUDhasyevArthasaMvittiH | nidrAdayaScatvAra ekaikaSaH gaNitAH | nidreti svapanam, tathAhi - `yadA tu manasi klAnte karmAtmAnaH kramAnvitAH | viShayeByo nivartante tadA svapati mAnavaH? iti | tandrA~api nidrABedaH, kathaM Binnatvena paThyate ? ucyate - nidrAyAmindriyamanomohaH, tandrAyAmindriyamoha ityatra BedaH | taduktam -`indriyArtheShvasaMprAptirgauravaM jRumBaNaM klamaH | nidrArtasyeva yasyehA tasya tandrAM vinirdiSet' iti | saMnyAsa iti | sa mUrcCAdiByo Binna eva, yataH `vAgdehamanasAM ceShTAmAkShipanti balAnmalAH | saMnyasyantyabalaM jantuM prANAyatanamASritAH || sa nA saMnyAsasaMnyastaH kAShThIBUto mRutopamaH | prANairvimucyate SIGraM tyaktvA sadyaHPalAM kriyAm ||' iti | glAniriti klamAparaparyAyasaMj~jA | yaduktaM - `yo~anAyAsaSramo dehe hRudayodveShTanaM klamaH | na cAnnamaBikA~gkSheta glAniM tasya vinirdiSet' iti | | sa ca hetucatuShTayAdBavati | `glAnirojaHkShayAdduHKAdajIrNAcca SramAdBavet' ityAdivacanAt | nanu mAdhavena mUrcCA ShaDvidhA svIkRutA yathA - `vAtAdiBiH SoNitena madyena ca viSheNa ca | ShaTsvapyetAsu pittaM tu praButvenAvatiShThate' iti | tatkathamatra caturvidhA ? satyam, pittapraButvena SoNitasya pittakAryatvAt madyaviShayoSca pittakopatvAcca pittasamBavAyAmatra SoNitAdInAM mUrcCA j~jAtavyeti na doShaH | yataH - `mUrcCA pittatamaHprAyA' ityAdivacanAt || 31 || 32 ||

gU0- atha mUrcCAsaMKyA - nidAne ShaDvidhA mUrcCA vAtapittakaPaistisraH, SoNitena madyena viSheNa ceti | kathaM sannipAtajA noktA ? ucyate, suSrutAdau tridoShajA doShajAntarBAvAtsaMKyAyAM noktA | agre liKitA tadyathA - `sarvAkRutiH sanni- pAtAdapasmAra ivAgatA | sA jantuM pAtayatyASu vinA bIBatsaceShTitaiH' iti | SoNitamadyaviShajA yo doShaje- ShvevAntarBAvAtsaMKyAtirekaH cikitsAmedArthaBinna uktaH BramaH ekaprakAraH raktapittAnilAdBrama iti BramalakShaNairapi triBireBiH eka eva ca BramaScakrArUDhasyeva viparItapadArthaj~jAnaM vA Brama iti BramalakShaNam | nidrAtandrA- glAnisaMnyAsasaMKyAmAha - ete ekaikaprakArAH | yeShAM niruktistu SArIre uktA || 31 || 32 ||

pada: mUrcCA caturvidhA j~jeyA vAtapittakaPaiH pRuthak ||31|| caturthI sannipAtena tathaikaSca BramaH smRutaH | nidrA tandrA ca saMnyAso glAniScaikaikaSaH smRutAH||32 ||

vya_text: dI0 - granthayo navadhA matA iti | granthistu SoPasamutthAno vraNaBedaH loke vatIgurIti SabdavAcyatvena pratIta: | tadyathA - `vAtAdayo mAMsamasRukpraduShTA: saMdUShya medaSca tathA SirASca | vRuttonnataM vigrathitaM tu SothaM kurvantyato granthiriti pradiShTaH' iti | navaprakAramAha - triBirdoShairiti | trayo BedAH, tena vyastena vAtena, pittena, kaPenetyarthaH | raktAdrudhirAccaturthaH | SirABiriti granthiH pa~jcamaH | medasA iti duShTamedasA janitaH ShaShThaH | vraNAditi vraNajanitaH saptamaH | asthneti doShadUShitAsthijanito~aShTamaH | mAMseneti mAMsajanito navama iti | nanu mAdhavena pa~jcaBedA grantha- yo~aBihitAH vAtAdidoSheNa trayaH medaHSirAByAM ca dvAviti, tatkathamatra navaBedA darSitAH ? ucyate, yadi mAMsAsRujAvatra dUShyaBedenodAhRutau tathApi granthyASrayatvena sthAnaviSeShAnmedaHSirAvattatsamBavasthAna evoktau | yaduktaM Boje - `medo vAyuryadA mAMse nikShipedathavA tvaci | tatra medoBavagranthiH SyAvo Bavati pANDuraH' ityAdinA | cikitsArthaM tu pRuthagaBidhAnamanyatrApi dRuSyate | taduktaM - `granthau mAMsodBave yojyo hyayameva kriyApathaH | SirAgranthiM parityajya SeShaM yatnena sAdhayet' ityAdiBiradoShaH || 68 ||

vya_text: dI0 - arbudamapi vraNaBedo vraNAkAratvAt | yataH - `gAtrapradeSe kvacideva doShAH samutthitA mAMsamasRuk pradUShya | vRuttaM mRudu mandarujaM mahAntamanalpamUlaM ciravRuddhyapAkam | kurvanti mAMsocCrayamatyagAdhaM tadarbudaM SAstravido vadanti' iti | ShaDvidhatvAcca sugamam | mAMsAdapi ceti | cakAragrahaNAdatra dvirarbudamapi grAhyam, adhyarbudamapi kecit | tathAhi -`yajjAyate~anyat Kalu pUrvajAte j~jeyaM tadadhyarbudamarbudaj~jaiH | yadvmandvajAtaM yugapat kramAdvA dvirarbudaM tacca BavedasAdhyam' iti ||69||

vya_text: dI0 - vidradhirapi vraNaBeda eva | yaduktam - `tvagraktamAMsamedAMsi pradUShyAsthisamASritAH | doShAH SothaM SanairGoraM janayantyucCritA BRuSam | mahAmUlaM rujAvantaM vRuttaM vApyathavAyatam | sa vidradhiriti KyAto vij~jeyaH ShaDvidhaSca saH' iti | carake tu vidAhaprakarShAdvidradhisaMj~jA | yaduktam - `sa vai SIGravidAhitvAd vidradhistu nirUpyate' iti | sa ca bAhyAByantare Bavati | antare tu gulmasAdRuSyam | yataH - `tulyadoShasamutthAno vidradhergulmakasya ca' iti | nanu tulya- tvAt kathaM vidradheH pAkaH kathaM vA gulmasya na pAkaH ? ucyate - `na nibandho~asti gulmAnAM vidradhiH sanibandhanaH | gulmAkAraM svayaM doSho vidradhirmAMsaSoNite | vivarAnucaro granthirapsu budbudako yathA | evaMprakAro gulmastu tasmAt pAkaM na gacCati' iti | tathA~anyatrApi - `mAMsaSoNitabAhulyAt pAkaM gacCati vidradhi: | mAMsaSoNitahInatvAt gulmaH pAkaM na gacCati' iti | ShaDvidhaprakAro~atra sugamaH | kShatAdityatra tu kAShThalaguDapAShANAdiprahArAt | tridoShairiti | militadoShatrayeNa sannipAtenetyarthaH || 70 ||
gU0 – vidradhisaMKyAmAha -- vidradhiH vaMkShaNadeSe vraNaviSeShaH so~api ShaDvidhaH || 70 ||

vya_text: dI0 - vraNaM tu SothasamutthAnaM kathitaM SothopalakShitamityarthaH | ata evAha kaScit pUrvarUpatvena yathA – ‘ekadeSasthitaH Sotho vraNAnAM pUrvalakShaNam' ityAdi sa ca SoPo vilakShaNaH unnataM pRuthuH grathitaH samo viShamo vA tva~gmAMsasthAyI doShasa~gGAtaH SarIraikadeSotthita ityucyate | teShAM caturdhA BedaH syAditi | teShAM vraNAnAM caturdhA Beda ityatra catuHprakAraBedatvena saMj~jABedaH sAmAnyo darSitaH | AganturdehajaH - Suddho duShTaSceti | Aganturiti saMGAtabalapravRuttaH; SastravyApadikRuta ityarthaH, dehajaH iti doShabalapravRuttaSarIrasaMj~jaH | yaduktam - `dvidhA vraNaH sa vij~jeyaH SArIrAgantuBedataH| doShairAdyastayoranyaH SastrAdikShatasamBavaH' iti | Suddha iti | SuddhavraNaH, yaduktaM `jihvAtalABo~atimRuduH SlakShNaH snigdho~alpavedanaH | suvyavastho nirAsrAvaH Suddho vraNa iti smRutaH' iti | duShTa iti duShTo vraNaH | yaduktam - `pUtiH pUyAtiduShTAsRuksrAvyutsa~ggI cirasthitiH | duShTavraNo~atigandhAdiH Suddhali~ggaviparyayaH' iti | kecittu SuddhaduShTaSabdau sAdhyAsAdhyatvena vyAKyAnayanti tanna sarvamatam | tatsaMKyA kathyate pRuthagiti | tadvraNasya saMKyA gaNanAniyamaH pRuthagaBinnatvenAtra kathyate, sA tu pa~jcadaSaprakArA vakShyamANA boddhavyA | yadyapi ShaDvidho~anyatra vraNaH pratipAditastathApyatra doShANAM prasaratvena pa~jcadaSaprakAro darSitaH | taduktaM suSrute -`kadAcidekaSo dviSo bahuSaH SoNitasahitA vA anekadhA prasaranti |' iti | tena pa~jcadaSaprakArA Bavanti, yataH `triBireva vAtAdikaiH SoNitacaturthai: SarIramidaM dhAryate' iti dvitIyadarSanAt | yaduktam - `kAlAntareNAByuditaM tu pittaM kRutvA vaSe vAtakaPau prasahya | pacatyata: SoNitameSha pAko mato~apareShAM viduShAM dvitIyaH' iti | pa~jcadaSasaMKyA subodhA iti || 70-75 ||

gU0 - vraNAH pa~jcadaSeti teShAM saMKyAmAha - te BedataScaturdhA | tadBedAnAha - pa~jcadaSavraNA uditAH kathitA iti pUrveNa sambandhaH | teShAM pa~jcadaSavraNAnAM caturdhA BedaH tatra ekaH AgantuSastrAdikShataja:, dvitIyo dehajaH SArIraH sa tu doShairjanyate ekaH Suddha: dvitIyo duShTaH evaM caturdhA BedaH | nanu nidAne dvividho BedaH proktaH taduktaM `dvidhA vraNaH parij~jeyaH SArIrAgantuBedataH | doShairAdyastatastanyaH SastrAdikShatasaMBavaH' iti, tatkatham ? ucyate, nidAne SuddhASuddhalakShaNaM Binnamuktam atastayormilitvA caturdheti na doShaH tatsaMKyA pa~jcadaSaprakArABidhA vAtAderBedataH pa~jcadaSavraNA BavantIti yojyam || 71-75 ||

pada: vraNAH pa~jcadaSoditAH | teShAM caturdhA BedAH syurAganturdehajastathA || 71|| Suddho duShTaSca vij~jeyastatsaMKyA kathyate pRuthak | vAtavraNaH pittajaSca kaPajo raktajo vraNaH || 72 || vAtapittaBavaScAnyo vAtaSleShmaBavastathA | tathA pittakaPAByAM ca sannipAtena cAShTama:|| 73 || navamo vAtaraktena daSamo raktapittataH | SleShmaraktaBavaScAnyo vAtapittAsRugudBavaH || 74 || vAtaSleShmAsRugutpannaH pittaSleShmAsrasaMBavaH | sannipAtAsRugudBUta iti pa~jcadaSa vraNAH || 75 ||

vya_text: dI0 - sadyovraNa iti | SastrAdiprahArajanita AgantukasaMj~jaH | sa cAnekAkRutirityeke BAShante | yaduktam -`nAnAdhAramuKaiH SastrairnAnAsthAnanipAtitaiH | Bavanti nAnAkRutayo vraNAstAMstAn nibodha me' iti | teShAM BedamAha -avaklRuptamityapakartanaM, vilambino lambanaSIlaH, mAMsAvalambanenetyaBiprAyaH | Cinnamiti | tiryag RujurvA CedanamavayavAdiShu gAtrasya pAtanamiti BAvaH | Binnamiti | koShThe bahudhA SaktikuntaKa~ggAgra- vidAraNAdiBirBedarUpam | yaduktam - `SaktikunteShu KaDgAgraviShANairASayo hataH | yat kiMcit sravate taddhi BinnalakShaNamucyate' iti | ASayo~atra sthAnaM tat koShThaSabdenopadarSitam | tadyathA - `sthAnAnyAmAgnipakvAnAM mUtrasya rudhirasya ca | hRuduNDukaH PupPusaSca koShTha ityaBidhIyate' iti | ata evASayarahite~anyadeSe vyadha eva vacanAt | pracalitA iti | prakarSheNa calitA mAMsAdikamiti BAvaH | tantrAntare picCitamiti nAmAntaraM - yataH `prahArapIDanAByAM tu yada~ggaM pRuthutA gatam | sAsthi tat picCitaM vidyAnmajjAraktapariplutam' iti | athavA pracalitamityanena yadvraNaM yadBagnasya tathA sadyovraNasya ca cikitsAviShayaM tena BagnAdhikAre pratipAdito~api tasyaivAtrAvasaro na doShaH majAraktapariplutatvena vraNaBAvatvAt | GRuShTamiva GRurShitaM, tadyathA - `GarShaNAdaBiGAtAdvA yada~ggaM vigatatvacam | uShAsravAnvitaM tattu GRuShTamityaBidhIyate' iti | viddhamiva viddham | yathA - sUkShmAsyaSalyABihataM yada~gga tvASayAdvinA | uttuNDitaM nirgataM vA tadviddhamiti nirdiSet' iti | nipAtita iti viSeSheNa pAtito~avayavAdyo yatra sa tathA, eke avaliptavilambinAM vivakShitamiti nAmnA ekameva BedaM pratipAdayanti tadyathA `nAticCinnaM nAtiBinnamuBayorlakShaNAnvitam | viShamaM vraNama~ggeShu tat kShataM tvaBinirdiSet' iti | atrAkRutiviShayatvAdaShTavidho liKito na doShaH || 76 ||

vya_text: dI0 - asthiBa~gga iti | asthiBa~ggaparyAyavAcako Bagna ityatra kathitaH, na tu BagnaSabdo~aShTasaMKyAyAmiha gaNitA:, te tu piShTavidAritAdayo~aShTau gaNitAH | agniveSe tu BagnaM dvividhaM kANDasandhimedAt | yaduktaM - `BagnaM samAsAddvividhaM hutASakANDe ca sandhAvapi tatra sandhau | utpiShThaviSliShTavivartitaM ca tiryaggataM kShipramadhaSca ShaT ca ||1||' atra tu yadvidAritordhvagau dvau BedAvadhikau liKitau tadgranthAntarasaMvAdAnna doShaH | yataH - adhaHkShiptavadUrdhvakShiptasyApyaBidhAne prApte~anuktamapyUrdhvakShiptABidhAnaM tenAtrordhvagaH pRuthagdarSitaH | yaduktaM - `adhaHkShiptordhvagAvetau tulyalakShaNasaMj~jakau' ityAdi | vidAritonAma BagnaScAsthiBa~ggenAnyatra pratipAditatvAda- trApi liKitaH, suSrute~apyayameva saMj~jAntareNa kathitaH | yaduktaM - `taruNAsthIni nAmyante Bidyante nalikAni ca | kapAlAsthIni Bajyante sPuTanti rucakAni ca ||' ityatra cakAragrahaNAdvalayAnyapi sPuTanti ityaBiprAyaH. | yato~asthIni pa~jcavidhAni Bavanti taruNanalakavalayakapAlarucakaBedAt | ata eva sPuTitamiti BagnaM suSrutenoktam | athoktapiShTavidAritAdInAmapi vivaraNamAha - sandhAvuBayataH Sotho vedanAdikaSca piShTasaMj~jaH | vidArita iti dvayoH sandhyayoratikrAntatA vedanA ca nivarteta ityekasandhipArSvagamanaM viShamA~ggatA vedanA ca viSliShTa iti manAk sandhiviSleShaH SithilatAmAtraM rAtrirujASothau ca | tiryakkShipta ityekaM sandhyasthisthAnaM tyaktvA tiryag yAti tadA tIvrapIDAH syuH | adhogata iti | vakShyamANordhvagalakShaNaH kiMcidadhogamanamiti SeShaH | Urdhvaga iti | viShamA rugapyasthnoratikShiptatvAt tena dvayorapyasthnoH parasparAtikramaNaM dUrAgamanamityarthaH | sandhiBagna iti | dvayoH sandhAnaM sandhiH, sandhestu viSleShaH sandhiBagnaH kathitaH | nanu kathaM sandhimuktatvena Bagnamucyate ? asthiviSleSho~atra Ba~gge~aBipretaH, yataH asthisandhyoH pRuthagBAvatvAttena kANDaBagnaM sandhiBagnaM cAgniveSe pUrvaM dvidhA pratipAditam | yaduktaM - `ShaDutpiShTAdiBedena sandhiviSleSha ucyate | kANDaBagno dvAdaSaBirBedaiH karkaTakAdiBiH' ityAdi | atra kANDaBagno~asthiBagnastasya dvAdaSaBedAH sandhiBagnAntarBUtA boddhavyA iti na doShaH | vahnidagdha iti | agnidagdhaScaturvidhaScatuHprakAraH, te ke prakArA ityAha - pluShTa ityAdi | yo vivarNamatimAtraM pluShyate sa pluShTaH, yatra tva~gmAMsAvalambanaM gAtraviSleShaH SirAsnAyusandhyasthivyApAdanaM jvaradAhapipAsAmUrcCAScopadravA Bavanti so~adagdhaH| yatrottiShThanti sPoTAstIvradAhavedanAScirAccopaSAmyanti sa durdagdhaH | samyag dagdha ityanavagADhaH, tAlavarNaH susaMsthita iti ||77||78||

vya_text: dI0 - atha nADIsaMKyA - nADya iti | nADIti gamBIragatiH pUyasyAtidUrapraveSanAdgatiriShyate | `nADIva yadvahati sA nADI' ityucyate | antaHSuShiranAlA nADI tena loke sarahASabdavAcyo vraNaviSeShaH | tathAhi - `SoPaM na pakvamiti pakvamupekShate yo yo vA vraNaM pracurapUyamasAdhuvRuttaH | aByantaraM praviSati pravidArya tasya sthAnAni pUrvavihitAni tataH sapUyaH | tasyAtimAtragamanAdgatirityataSca nADIva yadvahati tena matA tu nADI' iti | pa~jca samAKyAteti pa~jcaprakArA vAtena pittena kaPaistridhA tridoShairapi Salyeneti | vAtena pittena kaPena trayo BedAH, tridoShairiti militadoShatrayeNa caturtha: | SalyenetyAgantunimittaH pa~jcamo Beda iti | SasyanimittalakShaNaM ca yathA - `naShTaM kathaMcidanumArgamudIriteShu sthAneShu SalyamacireNa gatiM karoti | yatPenilaM mathitamuShNamasRug vimiSraM srAvaM karoti sahasA sarujA ca nityam' iti || 79 ||

vya_text: dI0 - tathAShTAviti | gudabastiBagadeSadAraNAdBagandaraH, BagaSabdo gudAdyupalakShaNaH | Boje~apyuktam - `BagaM parisamantAcca gudaM basti tathaiva ca | BagavaddArayedyasmAttasmAjj~jeyo BagandaraH' iti | aShTAvityatrAShTasaMKyAH syustAstu SataponakapraBRutayaH | SataponakatulyatvAt SataponakaH, sa tu vAtaprAyaH, SataponaScAlanikA iti loke | sahasradhAramanye | uShTragrIva iti | piDakAvasthAgatavakratvenoShTragrIvAkArastenoShTragrIvasaMj~jaH | ayaM tu pittabahulaH | parisrAvayogAt | parisrAvI kaNDUmAn Bavati sa ca kaPaprAyaH | RujurvAtakaPodBava iti vAtakaPalakShaNAByAM yukta RujuH | parikShepI marutpittAditi | vAtapittalakShaNAByAM yuktaH parikShepI | gudopari samantAt prasaraNaSIla iti BAvaH | prAyeNArSojamAha - arSojaH kaPapittataH iti kaPapittacihnAByAM milito~arSoja ityarSoBagandaraH iti | tadyathA - `kaPapitte sapUrvottho durnAmAsRujakopataH | arSomUle tataH SothaM kaNDUdAhAhimAn Bavet || sa SIGrapakvaBinnAsya: kledayan mUlamarSasaH | sravatyajasraM ca pUtirayamarSoBagandaraH' iti | AgantujAtaSconmArgIti Agantuja: prahArAdijanito Bagandara unmArgisaMj~jo Bavati | unmArgeNa kRumikRutamArgeNa purIShAdigamanAt | Sa~gKAvarta iti Sa~gKAvarto nAma BagandarastridoShajanito j~jeyaH | SambUkAvartavadvraNaviSeShapUrNanandyA~a~avartavadvA SambUkAvarta Avarto doShagativiSeShAdBavati | tathAca BojaH - `nadInAM paripUrNAnAM SambUkAvartakA yathA | samuttiShThanti vegena toyavegasamIritAH' iti | nanu mAdhavena BagandaraH pa~jcavidha uktaH | tathAhi - `gudasya dvya~ggule kShetre pArSvataH piDakArtikRut | Binno Bagandaro j~jeyaH sa ca pa~jcavidho mataH' iti | tatkathamatrAShTavidhaH ? ucyate -mAdhavanidAne tu trayaH saMsargaBedAH SataponakAdInAM doShalakShaNadarSanAtteShvevAntarBAvyAH, anyatra pratipAditaBinnalakShaNatvAccikitsArthaM pRuthagdarSito na doShaH | arSoBagandare pratipAditatvAt|| 80 || 81 ||

vya_text: dI0 - meDhre pa~jcopadaMSAH syuriti | upadaMSasaMj~jA rUDhA boddhavyA, vraNaviSeShatvena meDhre li~gge pa~jcaprakAro Bavati | yaduktamanyatrApi - `hastABiGAtAnnaKadantaGAtAdadhAvanAdatyupasevanAdvA | yonipradoShAcca Bavanti SiSne pa~jcopadaMSA vividhopacAraiH' iti | pa~jcaprakArA atra sugamAH | cakArAlli~gge li~ggavartiriti Bedo~atra j~jAtavyaH | yaduktam -`a~gkurairiva saMGAtairuparyuparisaMsthitaiH | krameNa jAyate vartistAmracUDaSiKopamA | koSasyAByantare sandhau parvasandhigatApi vA | li~ggavartiriti KyAtA li~ggArSa iti cApare' | atrAcAryeNAyamapi vakShyamANaSUkadoSheShu paThito na doShaH ekasthAnagatasAdharmyAt | yadyapyaBiGAtakShate mehane upadaMSe AgantuH ShaShThaH samBavI tathApi tasya doShali~ggavyutkAntatayA doShajeShvevAntarBAvaH | | ata evAha kaScit - `veganigrahadIrGAtiKaraSayyAdisevanaiH | doShA duShTA gatA guhyaM trayoviMSatirAmayAn' ityAdi | trayoviMSatirityanena pa~jcopadaMSA daSa cAShTau ca SUkajA ityarthaH | guhyaSabdatvenApi strINAmeShAM samBavaH kvaciditi BAva: | yataH - `rujAdAhArtibahulAstRuShNAtodasamanvitAH | strINAM puMsAM ca jAyante upadaMSAH sudAruNAH' iti pAThaH prAyeNArSha ityAhuH || 82 ||

`tameva BinnadurgandhaM GRutamedovasAniBam | SirAH sravantItyaniSaM tadA syAcCarkarA~arbudam' iti | indravRuddheti | madhye puShkaravat piDakABiH samAcitendravRuddhA kathitA | panasiketi | karNasyAByantare SAlUkavadugrarugvraNaviSeShaH | Boje karNasya samantata iti | tena karNasya bahirapi BavatItyAcakShate | yaduktam - `vivRutAsyAM mahAdAhAM pakvodumbarasanniBAm | sumaNDalAM pittakRutAM vivRutAnAmikAM viduH' iti | andhAlajIti | andhAlajI bahirvakrarahitA AntarmuKI srAvAnvitA ca | yaduktam - `kaPAnilau Sritau snAyuM piDakAM parimaNDalAm | duShTau janayataScaikAmalpapUyA~alpakaNDurAm | AmodumbarasaMkASAM vidyAdandhAlajIM tu tAm' iti | varAhadaMShTra iti | SUkaradaMShTrAkAratvena varAhadaMSe vraNaviSeShaH | sa ca visarpali~gga iti kecit | uktam - vidAhAdamlaguNaH pittamamlapittavidagdhamamlatAmupaitItyAdinA tiktAmlavAntatvAcca | ata evAmlapittaM pradhAnaM vAtakaPAvapyatrAnugatau gauravodgAravarmAdinA j~jeyau | tathAhi - `avipAkaklamotkleSatiktAmlodgAragauravaiH | hRutkaNThadAhAruciBiramlapittaM vadedBiShak' iti | kecidamlapitte milite kaPapitte sAmAnyaM kartRutvaM sthitamityAhuH | `karacaraNadAhamauShNyaM mahatImaruciM jvaraM ca kaPapittam | janayati kaNDUmaNDalapiDakASatanicitagAtrarogacayam' iti traividhyamasya prasiddham | eke `amlapittaM dvidhA prokta- mUrdhvAdho BedatastathA' iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | tatra prayAtyadho vA vividhaprakAramityAdinA kRutArtha- tvAdvAtaharitapItanIlakRuShNamityAdivAkyenordhvamiti | vAtaraktamiti | kupito vAtaH raktaM ca kupitaM vAtarakta- mityucyate | vAtasya prAbalyAt prAdhAnyAcca vAtaraktavyapadeSaH, na tu raktavAtaH | yataH - vya_text: dI0 - tathA nAsABavA gadA ityAdi | tatheti indriyAdhiShThitarogagaNanAsambandhAt | nAsABavA rogA aShTAdaSa samAKyAtAsteShvAdau pa~jcadhA pratiSyAyamAha - taduktaM carake - `GrANamUle sthitaH SleShmA rudhiraM pittameva ca | mArutAdhmAtaSiraso mArutaM SyAyate prati' iti || pa~jcadheti pa~jcaprakAraH, sa tu vAtAdidoShaBedena Bavati | teShAM keShAMcit j~jApanArthaM lakShaNAnyAha – yaduktam - `AnaddhA pihitA nAsA tanusrAvaprasekinI | galatAlvoShThaSoShaSca nistodaH Sa~gKayorapi | kShavapravRuttiratyarthaM vakravairasyameva ca | Bavet svaropaGAtaSca pratiSyAye~anilAtmake' iti | pittajamAha - `uShNaH sapItaka: srAvo GrANAt sravati paittike | kRuSo~atipANDuH saMtapto Bavet tRuShNAnipIDitaH | sadhUmamagniM sahasA vamatIva sa mAnavaH' iti | kaPajamAha - `GrANAt kaPakRute SItaH kaPaH pANDurvrajedbahu: | SuklAvaBAsaH SUnAkSho BavedguruSirA naraH | kaNThatAlvoShThaSirasAM kaNDUBiraBipIDitaH' iti | raktajamAha - `raktaje tu pratiSyAye raktasrAvaH prapadyate | tAmrAkShaSca BavejjantururoGAtAtprapIDitaH | durgandhocCvAsavadanagandhAnapi na vetti saH' iti | atrApi pittapratiSyAyali~ggAnyapi boddhavyAni tulyatvAt pittaraktayoH | yaduktam - `pittapra- tiSyAyakRutairli~ggaiScApi samanvitaH' iti | saMnipAtajamAha - `BUtvA BUtvA pratiSyAyo yasyA~akasmAnnivartate | saMpakvo vApyapakvo vA sa sarvapraBavaH smRutaH' iti | atra yadyapi doShatrayali~ggAni noktAni tathApi sarvatraBavAt j~jAtavyAni | asAdhyaScAyaM duShTatAM gataH sanniti vadanti | tasmAdanyatra duShTapratiSyAyalakShaNaM (atidurgandharogANAM) na pRuthak liKitam | tadyathA - `praklidyate punarnAsA punaSca pariSuShyati | punarAnahyate cApi punarvivriyate tathA | niHSvAsaScAtidurgandhaM naro gandhaM na vetti ca | evaM duShTapratiSyAyaM jAnIyAt kRucCrasAdhanam iti | ayaM ca pa~jcapratiSyAyAnAmevAvasthAntaratayA na ShaShTho gaNanIyaH | yataH sarve pratiSyAyA apratikriyamANA kAlAntareNa duShTatAM yAntIti vacanAt | tathAhi - `sarva eva pratiSyAyA narasyApratikAriNaH | duShTatAM yAnti kAlena tadA~asAdhyA Bavanti hi' iti | apInasa iti | pInaso nAsArogaviSeShaH pratiSyAyasamAnali~gga iti kecit | yaduktam | `Anahyate yasya viSuShyate ca praklidyate dhUpyati caiva nAsA | na vetti yo gandharasAMSca janturjuShTaM vyavasyet tamapInasena | taM vAnilaSleShmaBavaM vikAraM brUyAt pratiSyAyasamAnali~ggam' iti | videhastu pittaSleShmajaM paThati | tadyathA - `mAtulu~gge citaH SleShmA yadA pittAdvidahyate | tadA~asRuk picCilaM nAsA bahusiMhANakaM sravet | sakaNDUdAhapAkaM ca tattu vidyAdapInasam' iti | yatra pUtivAyurvahati sa pUtinAsasaMj~jo rogaH kathitaH | tathAhi -`doShairvidagdhairgalatAlumUle saMmUrCito yasya samIraNastu | nireti pUtiM muKanAsikAByAM taM pUtinAsaM pravadanti rogam' iti | doShairatyantapittakaParaktaiH, raktasyApi doShatulyarUpatvAddoShatvaM bahuvacananirdeSatvAcca | tathA videhe~apyuktam -`kaPapittAsrasaMmiSraM saMcitaM mUrdhni drehinam | vidagdhamUShmaNA gADhaM rujAM kRutvA~akShiSa~gKajAm | tataH prasyandate GrANAtsaraktaM pUtipItakam | pUtinasyaM tu taM vidyAd GrANakaNDUjvarapradam' iti | nAsArSa iti | nAsikAdijAtAnA- marSasAM cAdhimAMsatvaM tena mAMsA~gkuratvasAdharmyAt SastrakShArAgnisAdhyatvAcca teShvarSaHprayogaH kRutaH | yaduktam -`doShastva~gmAMsamedAMsi saMdUShya vividhAkRutIn | mAMsA~gkurAnapAnAdau kurvantyarSAMsi tAn jaguH' ityatrAdiSabdena nAsikASravaNacakShurmeDhranABipraBRutayo gRuhyante | eShAM lakShaNAni suSrute paThitAni | ata eva suSrutena nAsArogA ekatriMSat saMgRuhItAH | tadyathA - `arbudaM saptadhA SothAScatvAro~arSaScaturvidham | caturvidhaM raktapittamuktaM GrANe~api tadviduH' ityAdi || eteShAM vivaraNaM tatraiva j~jAtavyam | BraMSathuriti | tatra saGano vidagdhaH kaPa eva li~ggaM sa BraMSathurnAma rogaH kathitaH | tathAhi - 'praBraSyate nAsikayorhi yasya sAndro vidagdho lavaNaH kaPastu | prAk saMcito mUrdhani sUryataptastaM BraMSathuM rogamudAharanti? iti | kShava iti | kShavaSCikkA, sa tu doShAgantujaBedena dvividho Bavati | tadyathA - 'GrANASrite marmaNi saMpraduShTo yasyA~anilo nAsikayA nireti | kaPAnuyAto bahuSaH saSabdaM taM rogamAhuH kShavathuM vidhij~jAH' iti | AgantujamAha - `tIkShNopayogAdupajiGrato vA BAvAn kaTUnarkanirIkShaNAdvA | sUtrAdiBirvA taruNAsthimarmaNyuddhATite~anyaH kShavathurnireti' iti | doShajAgantuja evAtra gaNanIyaH | nAsAnAha iti | Anahyate ityAnAhaH nAsApratinAha ityarthaH| yaduktam - `ucCvAsamArgaM tu kaPaH savAto rundhyAt pratInAhamudAharanti' iti | videhe~apyuktam, yathA - `kaPAvRuto yadA vAyuryasya GrANe ca tiShThati | vRuNotIva tadA GrANaM sa pratInAha ucyate'iti | pUtiraktamiti | pUyaraktamiti pAThAntaram doShAgantujaBedAt pratipAditam | yaduktam - `doShairvidagdhairathavApi jantorlalATadeSe~aBihatasya taistaiH | nAsA sravet pUyamasRugvimiSraM taM pUyaraktaM pravadanti rogam' iti | arbudamiti | nAsArbudaM prasiddham | suSrute tu ekatriMSadgaNanApUrNanAya saptadhArbudhasya saMgrahaH | tatra. vAtapittakaPamAMsaraktamedoBavatvena ShaDvidhamarbudaM SAlAkyaprasiddham | videhena sannipAtajamadhikamuktam | evaM saptavidhamarbudaM nAsArogeShu suSrutenoktam | atra tu nAmamAtreNaiva kRutArthatvAt | duShTapInasamiti | pInasaM nAsAroge prasiddham | duShTatvamatra vikRutadoShArabdhatvAt | ata eva pakvAmaBedena dvividhamityAcakShate | tadyathA -`SirogurutvamarucirnAsAsrAvastanuH KaraH | kShAmaHShThIvatyathABIkShNamAmapInasalakShaNam' iti | pakvalakShaNamAha -`Amali~ggAnvitaH SleShmA GanaH KeShu nimajati | svaravarNaviSuddhiSca paripakvasya lakShaNam' iti | nAsASoSha iti | nAsAyAM SoSho~atra pariSoShaH | yaduktam - `GrANASrite srotasi mArutena gADhaM pratapte pariSoShite ca | kRucCrocCvasedUrdhvamadhaSca janturyasmin sa nAsApariSoSha uktaH' | atra pratapta ityanena ca raktapitte~api gamyate videhoktatvAt | yataH `vAtapittaM yadA GrANaM kaParakte viSoShayet | tadA kRucCrocCvasejjanturnAsA SuShkA vidIryate | sravatkIrNeva cUrNena nAsASoShaM tu taM viduH' iti | GrANapAka iti | GrANapAko nAsApAkaH sa ca vraNa ityupalakShita ityaBiprAyaH | yaduktam - `GrANASritaM pittamarUMShi kuryAdyasmin vikAre balavAMSca pAkaH | taM nAsikApAkamiti vyavasyedvikledakothAvathavApi yatra' iti | pUyasrAva iti | pUyasrAvo nAsAsrAvaH | tadyathA - `GrANAdGanaH pItasitastanurvA doShaH sravet srAvamudAharettam' (iti) videhe~api `srotaH SRu~ggATake SleShmA citaH kleditamUShmaNA | viSeShAt syandate rAtrau nAsAsrAvaM tu taM viduH' iti | dIptakamiti | yatra prajvaliteva nAsA Bavati | tathAcoktam -`GrANe BRuSaM dAhasamanvite tu viniHsareddhUma iveha vAyuH | nAsA pratapteva ca yasya jantorvyAdhiM tu taM dIptamudAharanti' iti | videhe~api yathA - `dhUmAyate yadA nAsA balAt kRuShyati dahyate | niScaret tata ucCvAso vyAdhiM taM dIptamAdiSet' iti || 146-148 ||
gU0 - nAsArogasaMKyA - tathA tena prakAreNa nAsABavA gadA aShTAdaSaiva saMKyAtAH te pratiSyAyAdayaH | nidAne ekaviMSatinAsArogA uktA atrAShTAdaSeti taccintyam || 146-148 ||

pada: tathA nAsABavA gadAH || 146 || aShTAdaSaiva saMKyAtAH pratiSyAyAstu teShvapi | vAtAtpittAttAtkaPAdraktAtsannipAtena pa~jcamaH || 147|| apInasaH pUtinAso nAsArSo BraMSathuH kShavaH | nAsAnAhaH pUtiraktamarbudaM duShTapInasam || 148 || nAsASoSho GrANapAkaH pUyasrAvaSca dIptakaH |

vya_text: gU0 - atha SirorogasaMKyA - tathA daSa SirorogA uktAH te ardhaBedakAdayaH | nidAne ekAdaSa SirorogAstaccintyam || 149 || 150 ||

pada: tathA daSa SirorogA vAtenArdhAvaBedakaH || 149 || SirastApaSca vAtena pittapIDA tRutIyakA | caturthI kaPajA pIDA raktajA sannipAtajA ||150|| sUryAvatAcCiraHkampAtkrimiBiH Sa~gKakena ca |

vya_text: dI0 - tathA daSa SirorogA ityAdi | tathetyUrdhvajatrugatarogaprastAvAt daSa SirorogAH kathitAH | SirorogaSabdena SirogataSUlarUpA rujo~aBidhIyante | ata eva SirorogA ityucyante | teShvardhAvaBedakamAha - ardhAvaBedako~ardhaSirovyathArUpa ityarthaH | tadyathA - `kevalaH sakaPo vA~ardhaM gRuhItvA Siraso~anilaH | manyA- BrUSa~gKakarNAkShilalATArdhe~ativedanAm | SastrAraNiniBAM kuryAt tIvrAM so~ardhAvaBedakaH | nayanaM cAthavA Srotrama- tivRuddho vinASayet' iti | nanu suSrute tvayaM doShajaH paThitaH | yathA - `yasyottamA~ggaM rujate~ardhamAtraM BedaBramamohaSUlaiH | pakShAddaSAhAdathavA~apyakasmAttamardhaBedaM tritayAdvyavasyet' iti | tat kathaM vAtenaiva darSitaH ? ucyate, vAtaprakopAdatra pittakaPau tasyA~anubandhau boddhavyau | yataH - `ekaH prakupito doShaH sarvAneva prakopayet' ityAdi | vikRutiviShayasamavAyArabdhatvAnnirdeSa ityadoShaH | tathAhyuktam - `sarva eva SirorogAH sannipAtasamudBavAH | oShadhyAdyaiSca baliBiH kIrtitAstadvidA daSa' iti | SirastApaSceti | ayaM ca vAtena Bavati | SirastApaH Siroruk | tantrAntare vAtajo~ayaM Siroroga ityarthaH | yaduktam - `yasyAnimittaM Siraso rujaSca Bavanti tIvrA niSi cAtimAtram | bandhopatApaiH praSamaSca yatra SiroBitApaH sa samIraNena' iti | pittAt pIDeti | Sira:pIDA pittaprakopAdapi Bavati| ayaM tRutIyo BedaH | yadyathA - `yasyoShNama~ggAracitaM tathaiva BavecCiro dhUpyati cAkShinAsam | SItena rAtrau ca BavecCamaSca SiroBitApaH sa ca pittakopAt' iti | caturthI kaPajA pIDeti | Sirasi kaPajA pIDA Bavati sa caturtho Beda ityaBiprAyaH | tadyathA - `Siro Bavedyasya kaPo~avadigdhaM guru pratiShTabdhamatho himaM ca | SUnAkShikUTaM vadanaM ca yasya SiroBitApaH sa kaPaprakopAt' iti | raktajeti | atra raktajA pIDA kathitA | `raktAtmakaH pittasamAnali~ggaH sparSAsahatvaM Siraso Bavecca' iti | sannipAtajeti | tridoShajanitApItyarthaH | tadyathA - `Siro~aBitApe tritayapravRutte sarvANi li~ggAni samudBavanti' iti | sUryAvartAditi | sUryAvartAdityanena pIDA kathitA | sA ca ruk sUryapravRuttau Bavati sUryA~apagame vinivartate sa sUryAvartaSabdavAcyo rogaH | tathAhi - `sUryodayaM yA pratimandamandamakShiBruvaM ruk samupaiti gADham | vivardhate cAMSumatA sahaiva sUryApavRuttau vinivartate ca | sarvAtmakaM kaShTatamaM vikAraM sUryApavartaM tamudAharanti' iti | SiraHpAkAditi | SiraHpAkAdevAsRugvasAdInAM saMkShayeNa Sirasi pIDA BavatItyaBiprAyaH | ata eva suSrute - kShayajo vikAra iti paThitaH | yataH `asRugvasASleShmasamIraNAnAM SirogatAnAmiha saMkShayeNa | kShayapravRuttaH Siraso~aBitApaH kaShTo BavedugrarujAtimAtram || saMsvedanaiSCardanadhUmanasyairasRugvimokShaiSca vivRuddhimeti' iti| ayaM videhe~api paThyate - `SUnyaM Bramati tudyeta SiroviBrAntanetratA | mUrcCA gAtrAvasAdaSca Siroroge kShayAtmake' iti | kRumiBiriti | Sirasi kRumijA pIDA Bavati iti | yaduktam - `nistudyate yasya Siro~atimAtraM saMBakShyamANaM sPuratIva cAntaH | GrANAcca gacCedrudhiraM sapUyaM Siro~aBitApaH kRumiBiH sa GoraH' iti | tathaivAha carakaH - `kRumINAM darSanena ca' iti | Sa~gKakeneti | Sa~gKadoSheShu duShTA doShAH Sothatvena rujAM kurvantItyanena Sa~gKarogo vAcyaH | tadyathA -`pittaraktA~anilA duShTAH Sa~gKadeSe vimUrcCitAH | tIvrarugdAharAgaM vA SothaM kurvanti dAruNam | sa SiroviShavadvegAnnirudhyASu galaM tathA | trirAtrAjjIvitaM hanti Sa~gKako nAmataH param | tryahAjjIvati BaiShajyaM pratyadhyeyaM samAcaret' iti | evaM suSrutoktA daSa SirorogAH pratipAditAH | mAdhavAcAryeNa tu svasaMgrahe~anantavAto~adhikaH paThitaH | tantrAntaradarSanAt | tadyathA - `doShAstu duShTAstraya eva manyAM saMpIDya GATAsu rujAM sutIvrAm | kurvanti yo~akShidhruvi Sa~gKadeSe sthitiM karotyASu viSeShataSca || gaNDasya pArSve tu karoti kampaM hanugrahaM locanajAMSca rogAn | anantavAtaM tamudAharanti doShatrayotthaM Siraso vikAram' iti | sarvatra sarvajeShu pratipAditatvAt atrApi na gaNitaH || 149 || 150 ||

dI0 - tathA kapAlarogAH syurnava teShUpaSIrShakamityAdi | SIrShakasamIpe SIrShakavat yaH SothaH sa upa- SIrShakaSabdavAcyaH | nIrukSoPatvAdupaSIrShakaH | yaduktam - `kapAle pavane duShTe garBasthasyA~api jAyate | savarNo nIrujaH SoPastaM vidyAdupaSIrShakam' iti | aruMShiketi | aruMShIti vraNAni kathitAni | tAnyapi Sirasi Bavanti | tadyathA - `aruMShi bahuvakrANi bahukledIni mUrdhani | kaPA~asRukkRumikopeNa nRuNAM vidyAdaruMShikAm' iti | vidradhiSceti | vidradhiH prasiddhA | sA tu mUrdhanyapi Bavati bahirgatamarmASritatvAt, asyA lakShaNaM vidradhinidAne j~jAtavyam | dAruNamiti | dAruNaM keSaBUmau Bavati | loke~api PyAMsaSabdavAcyo#foot@pArSaH pA0 ‘PiyASa’ pA0 |# roga viSeShaH | taduktam -`dAruNA kaNDarA rUkShA keSaBUmi: prajAyate | kaPavAtaprakopeNa vidyAddAruNakaM tu tam' iti | yadyapi kaPavAtaprakopAdityuktaM tathApi atra pittaraktAnubandho draShTavyaH | yaduktaM videhe - `yadaBrapaTalABAsaM sarajaskaM Sirastvaci | pAruShyaM jAyate jantostasya rUpaM viSeShataH || todaiH samanvitaM vAtAt sakaNDu gauravaM kaPAt | sapipAsaM sadAhArtirogaM pittAsrajaM tathA' iti | piDaketi | Sirasi yAH piDakA Bavanti tAH piDakAH rogA kathitAH | ayameva kShudrarogeShu irivellikASabdavAcyaH| tathAhi - `piDakAmuttamA~ggasthAM vRuttAmugrarujAjvarI | sarvAtmikAM sarvali~ggAM jAnIyAdirivellikAm' iti | atra tu SiraHsthitatvAt liKitA iti na doShaH | arbudamiti | arbudavadarbudaM vraNaviSeShaH | `gAtrapradeSe kvacideva' ityaniyamAcCirasyapi Bavati | tallakShaNaM tatraiva boddhavyam | indraluptamiti | indralupto `vAdipurA' SabdavAcyo romaviSeShaH | asyaiva paryAyakathanaM KAlityaM ruk ceti | tathAhyuktam – ‘romakUpAnugaM pittaM vAtena saha mUrcCitam | pracyAvayati romANi tataH SleShmA saSoNitaH || ruNaddhi romakUpAMstu tato~anyeShAmasaMBavaH | tadindraluptaM KAlityaM ruk ceti ca viBAvyate' iti | atra tu indraluptaKAlityayoH pRuthaggrahaNaM kArtikAcAryavacanAt | tanmate tu indraluptaM SmaSruShu Bavati | KAlityaM Sirasyeva, ata eva videhavacanAdindraluptaM strINAM na Bavati | yaduktam – ‘atyantasukumArA~ggyo rajo duShTaM sravanti ca | avyAyAmaratA yasmAnnendraluptaM tataH striyAH' iti | evamindraluptaM KalatiSca pRuthagatra nirUpitam | palitamiti | keSAnA SuklaBAvena palitamityucyate | tadyathA - `krodhaSokaSramakRutaH SarIroShmA SirogataH | pittaM ca keSAn pacati palitaM tena jAyate' iti | tat palitaM dvividhaM Bavati, akAlajanitaM kAlajanitaM ca, atraivoktatvAt | yataH krodhAdikRutena vaikRutaM, pittena punaH prAkRutaM palitamiti | anyathA pittoShmaNoraBedAt punaruktidoShaH syAt | etena vaikRutamakAlajaM, vaya:kRutaM tu pittenetyarthaH | kecidetaccAkAlajalakShaNaM manyante | anyaistriBireva doShaH syAditi kathayanti, tatra SokaSramAByAM janitavAtena SarIroShmaNo vikShepAcCirogatatvaM tenA~anilo~api laByate pittaM ca sAkShAdupAttaM, SleShmA~api keSaSuklatAkaraNako gRuhyate | etena doShatrayasahitaH SarIroShmA palitaheturiti vAkyArthaH | yaduktaM carake - `tejonilAdyaiH saha keSaBUmiM labdhvA tu kuryAt palitaM narasya | kiMcittu dagdhvA palitAni kuryAddharitpraBatvaM ca SiroruhANAm' iti || 151 || 152 ||
gU0 - atha kapAlarogasaMravyA - tathA navakapAlarogAH syu:, te tu upaSIrShAdayaH || 151 || 152 ||

pada: tathA kapAlarogAH syurnava teShUpaSIrShakam ||151|| aruMShikA vidradhiSca dAruNaM piDikA~arbudam | indraluptaM ca KalatiH palitaM ceti te nava || 152 ||

vya_text: dI0 - tathetyanenendriyasAdharmyAnnAsASravaNAdInAmanantaraM netrarogagaNanAramBa ityaBiprAyaH | sA caturnavatisaMKyA-kairAmayaiH pratipAditA | tadyathA - `nava rogA netrasandhau caturviMSativartmajAH | kRuShNaBAgagatAH pa~jca SuklaBAge trayodaSa | ShaT kAce ShaT ca timire aShTau dRuShTigatA matAH | li~gganASAstathA sapta catvAraScAdhimanthajAH | aBiShyandASca catvArastathA~aShTau sarvajAH smRutAH' ityatrAcAryeNa saMgRuhItAH | suSrute tu sthAnaviSeShAdeva ShaTsaptatiH kathitAH | yataH - `nava sandhyASrayAsteShu vartmajAstvekaviMSatiH | SuklaBAge daSaikastu catvAraH kRuShNaBAgajAH || sarvASrayAH saptadaSa dRuShTijA dvAdaSaiva tu | dvau ca bAhyASrayAvantau tvanimittanimittajau || ShaTsaptatirnetrarogAH saMgraheNa prakIrtitAH' iti | doShaBedenA~api ShaTsaptatireva | yadAha suSrutaH - `taistriBistriMSaduktAste kaPenAByadhikAstrayaH | raktajAH ShoDaSa j~jeyAH sarvajAH pa~jcaviMSatiH || bAhyau punardvau ca tathA rogAH ShaTsaptatiH smRutAH' iti | atra SAr~ggadharAcAryeNa yaccaturnavatisaMKyAgrahaNaM kRutaM tannetrarogAntarnetraroganidAnatayA pratipAditatvAt | yathA sarvanetrAmayAnAM hetuBUto~aBiShyanda iti | taduktam - `vAtAt pittAt kaPAdraktAdaBiShyandaScaturvidhaH | prAyeNa jAyate GoraH sarvanetrAmayAkaraH' iti | suSrute~api yathA - `prAyeNa sarve nayanA~a~amayAste BavantyaBiShyandanimittamUlA:' iti | adhimanthasyApyaBiShyandajanyatvam | yaduktam -`vRuddhairetairaBiShyandairnarANAmakriyAvatAm | tAvantyastvadhimanthAH syurnayane tIvravedanA' iti | tathaiva dRuShTigatarogANAmapi timirakAcali~gganASASca hetuBUtaparamparayA vyavasthitAH | tadyathA - `timiraM rAgatAM yAti rAgaH kAcatvameti ca | kAcAt saMjAyate nIlI tadAndho jAyate naraH' ityAdinA | tenA~atra nidAnaBUtAnAM rogANAmapi saMgrahaH kRuta ityadoShaH | eteShAM lakShaNAni vakShyamANeShu netragadeShu darSayiShyAmaH || atha caturnavatinetrarogANAM vivaraNamAha - teShu vartmagadA ityAdi | teShu pUrvoktacaturnavatisaMKyAgadeShu vartmagadAH pakShmamUlagatarogAH | te caturviMSatiBedAH kRucCronmIlapraBRutayaH | tadyathA kRucCronmIla iti | yatra kRucCreNa mahatA kaShTena unmIlanamuddhATanaM Bavati | ata eva tantrAntare ku~jcanaM nAmeti kathayanti | yathA - `'vAtAdyA vartmasaMkocaM janayanti malA yadA | tadA draShTraM na Sakroti ku~jcanaM nAma tadviduH' iti | pakShmaNAM SAtanaM Bavati sa pakShmaGAta iti kathitaH | tenAnyatra pakShmaSAtaH prasiddhaH | yaduktam - `vartmapakShmASayagataM pittaM romANi SAtayet | kaNDUM dAhaM ca kurute pakShmaSAtaM tamAdiSet' iti | kaPotkliShTa iti | kaPasyotkliShTatvena praklinnavartmatvaM janyate tena praklinnavartmeti nAmnA prasiddhaH | tadyathA - `arujaM bAhyataH SUnaM vartma yasya narasya hi | praklinnavartma tadvidyAt klinnamatyarthamantarA' iti | etena cakShuShyeNa pillAKyaM paThitam | yathA - `BRuSaM praklidyate vartma kaNDUmanmandavedanam | vidyAt praklinnavartmeti tat pillaM sannipAtajam' iti | lohita iti | lohitAkArA~gkuratvena yathArSastathAyamapi | ata- evAnyatra SuShkArSaH kathitam | tadyathA - `dIrGA~gkuraH KaraH stabdho dAruNo hyantarodBavaH | vyAdhireSho~aBiviKyAtaH SuShkArSa iti saMj~jitaH' iti | nimeSha iti nimeShasaMj~jayA prasiddhaH | yataH - `nimeShiNIH sirA vAyuH praviShTo vartmasaMSrayaH | cAlayatyakShivartmAni nimeSha iti taM viduH' iti | ayamapi videhe asAdhyaH kathitaH | yaduktam -`nimeShiNIH sirA vAyuH praviSya vyavatiShThate | atyarthaM cAlayedvartmanimeShaH sa na siddhyati ||' raktotkliShTa iti raktenotkliShTatvAdraktArSo~anyatra pratipAditam | yathA - `yaH sthito vartmamadhye tu lohito mRudura~gkaraH | tadraktajaM SoNitArSaSCinnaM BinnaM pravardhate' iti | etadasAdhyatvena videhe~api darSitam | yathA - `vAyuH SoNitamAdAya sirANAM pramuKasthitaH | janayatya~gkuraM tAmraM vartmani cCinnarohaNam | tacCoNitArSo~asAdhyaM syAdraktasrAvyatha nIrujam' iti | kukUNako~anyatra bAlaroge paThitaH | bAlAnAmatIva samBavatvAt | akShigataBAgenAtra gaNito na doShaH | tadyathA - `kukUNakaH kShIradoShAcCiSUnAmakShivartmani | jAyate tena tannetraM kaNDUraM ca sravenmuhuH | SiSuH kuryAllalATAkShikU- TanAsAvaGarShaNam | Sakto nArkapraBAM draShTuM na vartmonmIlane kShamaH' iti | pakShmArSa iti | yatra karkaTIbIjasadRuSAH piDakA vartmano~aByantarbahiH sravanti tat pakShmArSaH kathitam | tathAhi - `ervArubIjapratimAH piDakA mandavedanAH | SlakShNA: KarASca vartmasthAstadarSovartma kIrtyate' iti | sannipAtajamidam | tathAca videhaH - `nIrujA kaThinA vartma pakShmAntarbAhyato~api vA | piDakA sannipAtena tadaSovartma kIrtyate' iti pakShmarodha iti | pakShmarodho vartmabandhaH kathitaH | yatra SothayogAnna yathAvannayanaM pidadhAti vartma eSha sannipAtajaH | tathAhi - `kaNDUmatAlpatodena vartmaSothena yo naraH | na sa sat CAdayedakShi BavedbandhaH sa vartmani' iti | pittotkliShTa iti | utkliShTaM pittaM yatra sa pakShmaprakopa iti nAmnA prasiddhaH | yaduktam - `pracAlitAni vAtena pakShmANyakShi viSanti hi | GRuShyantyakShi muhustAni saMramBaM janayanti ca || asite ca site BAge mUlakoSAt patanti hi | pakShmakopaH sa vij~jeyo vyAdhiH paramadAruNaH' iti | ayamapi sannipAtajo yApya eva | pothakIti | yatra sarShapasadRuSAH piDakA Bavanti sa pothakISabdavAcyaH | yathA - `srAviNyaH kaNDarA gurvyo raktasarShapasanniBAH | piDakASca rujAvantyaH pothakya iti tAH smRutAH' iti | SliShTavartmeti | vartmanaH SliShTatvena | aklinnavartma iti nAmAntaraM pakShmaNAmasaMlagnatvAt | tathAhi — ‘yasya dhautAnyadhautAni saMnahyante punaH punaH | vartmAnyapariklinnAni vidyAdaklinnavartma tat' iti | eke SliShTasthAne kliShTavartmeti paThanti | tatra kliShTatvaM vedanAlpayogAdavagantavyam | yataH - `mRudvalpavedanaM tAmraM yadvartma samameva ca | akasmAcca BavedraktaM kliShTavartmeti tadviduH' iti | bahala iti | yatra tvagvarNasadRuSyaH piDakA Bavanti tadbahalavarmeti saMj~jayA kathitam | tathAhi - `vartmopacIyate yasya piDakABiH samantataH | savarNABiH sthirABiSca vidyAdbahalavartma tat' iti | pakShmotsa~gga iti | vartmana evAByantare upari sotsedhA piDakA jAyate | tenotsa~ggapiDakAnyatra kathitA | yathA - `aByantaramuKI tAmrA bAhyato vartmanaSca yA | sotsa~ggotsa~ggapiDakA raktajA sthUlakaNDarA' iti | iyamapi videhagadAdharAByAM vartmani eva jAtA darSitA | yadAhatuH - `vartmotsa~gge~adhare jantoH saMnipAtAt prajAyate | aByantaramuKI sthUlA bAhyataScApi dRuSyate| piDakA piDakABiSca citA~anyABiH samantataH | utsa~ggapiDakA nAma kaThinA mandavedanA | praBinnA saMsravet srAvaM kukkuTANDarasopamam' iti | arbudamiti | vartmArbudaM tacca granthirUpeNa sthitam | tadyathA - `vartmAntarasthaM viShamaM granthiBUtamavedanam | AcakShate~arbudamiti saraktamavilambitam' iti | kumBiketi kumBANDulatA tadbIjatulyA kumBikA vAcyA | anye kumBIkA kacCadeSodBavA dADimAkAraPalA | tadvIjatulyapiDakA BidyamAnA satI svayameva pUrNodarA Bavati | yaduktam -`vartmAnte piDakA dhmAtA Bidyante ca sravanti ca | kumBIkAbIjasadRuSAH kumBIkA: saMnipAtajAH' iti | sikatAvartmeti | sikatA SarkarA tatsadRuSABiH piDakABiScitaM yadvartma Bavati tat sikatAvartmeti kathitam | tadyathA - `piDakABiH susUkShmABirGanABiraBisaMvRutA | piDakA yA KarA sthUlA sA j~jeyA vartmaSarkarA iti | alagana iti | yatra vartmamUle kolapramANo granthiH sa alagana iti rogaviSeShaH kathitaH | tathAca - `apAkI kaThinaH sthUlo granthirvartmaBavo~arujaH | sakaNDUpicCilaH kolapramANo~alagano~astu saH' iti | a~jjananAmiketi | vartmajA komalA yA piDakA sA~a~jjananAmiketi prasiddhA | yaduktam - `dAhatodavatI tAmrA piDakA yA tu vartmajA | mRudvI mandarujA sUkShmA j~jeyA sAM~a~jjananAmikA' iti | kardama iti | prAguktakliShTalakShaNameva yadA pittaM militaM punaH SoNitaM viklinnatvamApannaM Bavati sa vartmakardama iti kathitaH | tathAhi - `kliShTaM punaH pittayutaM SoNitaM vidahedyadA | tataH klinnatvamApannamucyate vartmakardamaH iti | SyAvavartmeti | SyAvatvamatra vAtAdhikatvena boddhavyam | ata eva vedanAnvitamityuktam | tathAhi - `vartma tadvAhyato~antaSca SyAvaM SUnaM savedanam | tadAhuH SyAvavartmeti netrarogaviSAradAH' iti | agnidagdhamiva SyAvatvamityeke | tathAca nimiH - `duShTaSleShmAnilAtpittaM vartmanoScIyate yadA | agnidagdhaniBaM SyAvaM SyAvavartmeti tadviduH' iti | visavartmeti | bisaM mRugAlaM tacCidrAkAraCidrAnvitaH Sotho vartmamUle Bavati tadvisavartmeti nAma kathitam | taduktam - `trayo doShA bahiH SothaM kuryuSCidrANi vartmano: | prasravantyantarudakaM visavadvisavartma tat' iti | alajIti | yadyapyalajI vakShyamANasandhigatarogeShu darSitA tathApyatra prasaMgAt prasiddhiMgatatvAt pakShmasandhAvapi BavatItyadoShaH| yaduktam - `vartulAkArapiDakA sUkShmA tAmrA ca vartmani | sarujA SoNitotkliShTA dAruNA tvalajI smRutA' iti | utkliShTavartmeti | utkliShTo vAtastena vyAptaM yadvartma | ata eva tantrAntare vAtahatavartma kathitam | yathA - `vimuktasandhi niSceShTaM vartma yasya nimIlyate | etadvAtahataM vartma jAnIyAdakShicintakaH' iti | evaM vartmarogAScaturviSatiH proktAH || idAnIM netrarogeShveva sandhigatAn navaBedAn Aha - netreti | pUrvokteShu caturnavatinetrarogeShu nava rogA ye sandhigatAsteShAM vivaraNaM liKyate | yathA - jalasrAva iti | jalasrAvo~atra pittAdboddhavyaH | jalABasrAvadarSanAt | tadyathA - `haridrABaM nIlamuShNaM jalABaM pittasrAvaH saMsravet sandhimadhyAt' iti | yatasa

gU0 - atha netrarogasaMKyA - iti caturviMSativartmajAH | atha nava netrasaMdhijAH nava nayanasaMdhiBavA rogAste jalasrAvAdayaH | atha trayodaSa sitaBAgagatAH | tathA trayodaSa rogA budhaiH sitaBAgagatAH SuklaBAgagatAH proktAH | te sirotpAtAdayaH | atha kRuShNagatA rogAH te pa~jca ete SuddhaSuklAdayaH pa~jca kRuShNasamudBUtAH proktAH | atha ShaDvidhakAcamAha - evaM vAtAdiBiH ShaDvidhaM kAcaM j~jeyam | ShaT timirANyAha - vAtAdiBiH ShaDeva timirANi rogA aShTAviMSatiruktAH || atha sapta (saMKyaH) li~gganASa Aha - `li~gganASaH saptadhA syAtsa tu vAtAdiBirj~jeyaH | upasargeNa kasyacitsambandhena saMsargajaH dvidoShajanyaH | athA~aShTadhA dRuShTirogAnAha - `aShTadhA dRuShTirogAH syurBaveyuste pittavidagdhAdayaH | atha catvAro~adhimanyAH, evaM catvAraH adhimanthAH syuH te vAtAdiBiH' athABiShyandAH, evaM catvAra: aBiShyandAH syu: te raktAdiBirj~jeyAH | atha sarvA~akShirogA aShTau syu: te tu vAtaviparyayAdayaH evaM caturnavatirnetrarogA uktAH | nanu nidAne ShaTsaptatirnetrarogA uktA atra caturnavatIti tatkatham ? ucyate - kasmiMcittantre adhikAH prAptA liKitA ato na doShaH || 153-160 ||

pada: tathA netraBavAH KyAtAScaturnavatirAmayAH | teShu vartmagadAH proktAScaturviMSatisaMj~jakAH || 153 || kRucCronmIlaH pakShmapAtaH kaPotkliShTaSca lohitaH | arunnimeShaH kathito raktotkliShTaH kukUNakaH || 154 || pakShmArSaH pakShmarodhaSca pittotkliShTaSca pothakI | kliShTavartmA ca bahalaH pakShmotsaMgastathArbudam || 155|| kumBikA sikatAvartma lagaNo~a~jjananAmikA | kardamaH SyAvavartmA ca bisavartmA tathA~alajI || 156|| utkliShTavartmeti gadAH proktA vartmasamudBavAH | netrasaMdhisamudBUtA nava rogAH prakIrtitAH || 157 || jalasrAvaH kaPasrAvo raktasrAvaSca parvaNI | pUyasrAvaH krimigranthirupanAhastathA~alajI || 158 || pUyAlasa iti proktA rogA nayanasaMdhijAH | tathA SuklagatA rogA budhaiH proktAstrayodaSa || 159|| sirotpAtaH sirAharShaH sirAjAlaSca SuklikA | SuklArma cAdhimAMsArma prastAryarma ca piShTakaH || 160 || SirAyAScippiTaM caiva kaPagrathitako~arjunaH | snAyvarma SoNitArma syAditi SuklagatA gadAH || 161|| tathA kRuShNasamudBUtAH pa~jca rogAH prakIrtitAH | SuddhaSukraM SirASukraM kShataSukraM tathA~ajakA || 162 || SirAsaMgaSca sarve~api proktA kRuShNagatA gadAH | kAcaM tu ShaDvidhaM j~jeyaM vAtAtpittAtkaPAdapi || 163 || sannipAtAcca raktAcca ShaShThaM saMsargasaMBavam | timirANi ShaDeva syurvAtapittakaPaistridhA || 164 || saMsargeNa ca raktena ShaShThaM syAtsaMnipAtataH | li~gganASaH saptadhA syAdvAtAtpittAtkaPena ca || 165|| tridoShairupasargeNa saMsargeNAsRujA tathA | aShTadhA dRuShTirogAH syusteShu pittavidagdhakam || 166|| amlapittavidagdhaM ca tathaivoShNavidagdhakam | nakulAndhyaM dhUsarAndhyaM ratryAndhyaM hrasvadRuShTikaH || 167 || gamBIradRuShTirityete rogA dRuShTigatA matAH ||118 || (catvAraScAdhimanthAH syurvAtapittakaPAsrataH || 168) aBiShyandASca catvAro raktAddoShaistriBistridhA | sarvAkShirogAScAShTau syusteShu vAtaviparyayaH || 169 || alpaSoPo~anyatovAtastathA pAkAtyayaH smRutaH | SuShkAkShipAkaSca tathA SoPo~adhyuShita eva ca || 170|| hatAdhimantha ityete rogAH sarvAkShisaMBavAH |

vya_text: dI0 - puMstveti | puMstvadoSho napuMsakaSabdavAcyaH | sa ca pa~jcaprakAro Bavati | tatrerShyakamAha | anyavyavAyaM dRuShTvA vyavAye pravartate yaH sa IrShyakaH | yaduktam - `dRuShTvA vyavAyamanyeShAM vyavAye yaH pravartate | IrShyakaH sa tu vij~jeyaH sadA rogaviSAradaiH' iti dRugyonirapIrShyakAparaparyAyaH | tathApi tantrAntare paThito heturyathA - `IrShyABiBUtAvapi mandaharShau IrShA ratereva vadanti hetum' iti | Asekya iti | yaH svaBAryayA yonyAdikaM spRuShTvA saMkalpapUrvakaM pravartate sa AsekyaH| suSrute tu - SukraM prASya dhvajadArDhyaM laBate yaH sa AsekyaH kathitaH | taduktam - `pitroratyalpavIryatvAdAsekyaH puruSho Bavet | sa SukraM prASya laBate dhvajocCrAyamasaMSayam' iti | ata evAsekyanAmAyaM ShaNDo muKayonyaparaparyAyaH kathitaH | kumBIka iti | yaH puruShaH svakIyapAyau anyapuruShapArSvAdvyavAyaM kArayitvA paScAt strIShu viShaye pumAn pravartate sa kumBIkaH | suSrute - `sve gude~abrahmacaryAdyaH strIShu puMvat pravartate| kumBIkaH sa tu vij~jeyo rogorogaviSAradaiH' iti | gudayonirayamaparaparyAyanAmnA kathitaH | asyotpattihetuSca tantrAntare varNitaH | yathA - `mAturvyavAyapratimena vakrI syAdbIjadaurbalyatayA pituSca' ityAdi | gayadAsastu kumBIkotpattau hetumAha yathA - `arajaskAM yadA nArIM SleShmalastu vrajedRutau | anyAsaktA Bavet prItirjAyate kumBikastadA' iti | sugandhIti | yo yonyAdigandhamAGrAya dhvajabalaM laBate sa sugandhIti nAma ShaNDhaH kathitaH | yaduktam - `yaH pUtiyonau jAyeta sa saugandhikasaMj~jitaH | sa yoniSePasorgandhamAGrAya laBate balam' iti | ayaM saugandhiko~api nAsAyonyaparaparyAyaH | ShaNDhasaMj~jita iti | yaH pumAn stryAkRutiH strIceShTitaSca strIvadadhoBUtaH svameDhrasyordhvapradeSe aparapuruShAt vIryacyutiM kArayati sa ShaNDhaH, utpattiviShayatvAt | yaduktam - `yo BAryAyAmRutau mohAda~gganeva pravartate | tatra strIceShTitAkAro jAyate ShaNDhasaMj~jitaH' iti | ayaM ShaNDhastu aretAH kathitaH | IrShyakAdayaScatvAraH saretasa ityuktatvAt | tathAhi - `AsekyaSca sugandhI ca kumBIkaScerShyakastathA | saretasastvamI j~jeyA aSukraH ShaNDhasaMj~jitaH || 171 ||
gU0 - atha pa~jca puMstvadoShAnAha - puMstvadoShAH pa~jcaiva syuste IrShyakAdayaH, eShAM lakShaNAni SArIre proktAni || 171||

pada: puMstvadoShAstu pa~jcaiva proktAstatrerShyakaH smRutaH || 171 || AsekyaScaiva kumBIkaH sugandhiH ShaNDhasaMj~jakaH |

vya_text: dI0 - doShairduShTaM SukraM SukradoSha ityucyate | tadyuktAH puruShA garBotpattau na kShamA iti | prayojanaM suSrutavacanAt | yataH -`vAtapittaSleShmakuNapagranthipUtipUyakShINamUtrapurISharetasaH prajotpAdane na samarthA Bavanti' iti | tatra SukraM yadA aruNakRuShNavarNaM Bavati todaBedanaviSeShAnvitaM ca Bavati tadvAtaduShTam | pittaduShTaM tu pItanIlAdivarNAnvitaM oShacoShavedanAviSeShayuktaM ca | kaPaduShTaM ca SvetavarNaM kaNDvAdivedanAnvitaM ca | kuNapaM cAsrapittAByAmiti | kuNapaH SavaH, tasyeva gandho yasya Sukrasya Bavati | so~api raktena pittena Bavati | analpaM ca Bavati | cakArAt SoNitavarNaM pittavedanaM ca | suSrute tvayaM raktaja ityuktaH, yataH - `kuNapagandhyanalpaM ca raktena' iti | atra rakteneti vyapadeSo GRutatailadagdhavat | yato raktasyApi doShA eva pradUShayitAraH | tenAtra asrapittAByAmiti grahaNaM na doShaH | pUyABaM SleShmapittayoreva iti | pittaSleShmaByAM yaddUShitaM taddhaTitaM pUyasadRuSaM SukraM Bavati | varNavedanAScAtra militaSleShmapi- ttayoreva boddhavyA: | kShINaM ca vAtapittAByAmiti | kAraNaiH svamAnAdalpIBUtam | lakShaNaM ca yathA - `daurbalyaM muKaSoShaSca pANDutvaM sadanaM BramaH | klaivyaM SukravisargaSca kShINaSukrasya lakShaNam' iti | granthilaM SleShmavAtata iti | granthilasadRuSaM granthilaM tat SleShmavAtajanitaM Bavati | atrApi dvidoShavarNavedanA boddhavyA | malABaM sannipAtAcceti | malaM mUtrapurISham, tadABaM tadgandhi ca yat SukraM Bavati tat sannipAtadUShitam | suSrute~api - `mUtrapurIShagandhisannipAtena' iti | iti pUrvoktaprakAreNa SukradoShA IritAH kathitAH || 172 || || 173 ||
gU0 - athA~aShTau SukradoShAH - tathA tena prakAreNa aShTau SukradoShAH syuH te vAtAderBedato j~jeyAH, eShAM lakShaNAni SArIre nidAne vA proktAni || 172 || 173 ||

pada: SukradoShAstathAShTau syurvAtAtpittAtkaPena ca || 172|| kuNapaM cAsrapittAByAM pUyABaM SleShmapittataH | kShINaM ca vAtapittAByAM granthilaM SleShmavAtataH|| 173|| malABaM saMnipAtAcca SukradoShA itIritAH |

vya_text: dI0 - strIrogetyAdi | strIShu BavA rogAH strIrogAH | teShAM puruSheShu na samBavatvAt | pUrvaSAstrata iti munivacanAt | teShvAdau ArtavadoShAnAha - `aShTau cArtavadoShAH syu'rityAdi | doShairduShTamArtavaM ca vIryavadBavatItiprayojanaScakAraH | yaduktaM suSrute - `Artavamapi triBirdoShaiH SoNitacaturthai: pRuthagdvandvai: samastaiScopasRuShTamabIjaM Bavati' iti | eteShAM doShavarNavedanAdiBirvij~jAnopAyaM kathitAShTaSukradoShe j~jAtavyam || tathA raktapradaramityAdi | tathetyanenArtavameva kAraNamasRugdarasyeti BAvaH sUcitaH | yaduktam - `tadevAtiprasa~ggena pravRuttamanRutAvapi | asRugdaraM vijAnIyAdato~anyadraktalakShaNam' iti | sAmAnyalakShaNamapi yathA – ‘asRugdaro Bavet sarvaH sA~ggamardaH savedanaH' iti | ArtavAtipravRuttitvenAsRugdaraH,tasmAttasyAtisrutasya lakShaNAni | yathA -`tasyAtivRuttau daurbalyaM Bramo mUrcCA madastRuShA | dAhaH pralApaH pANDutvaM tandrA rogASca vAtajAH' iti | tasya saMKyAScatuHprakArA Bavanti | vAtapittakaPairityAdi | tatra vAtikamAha - `rUkShAruNaM PenilamalpamalpaM vAtAt satodaM piSitodakABam' iti | pittajamAha - `sapItanIlAsitaraktamuShNaM pittArtiyuktaM mRuSavegi pittAt' iti | kaPajamAha - `AmaM sapicCApratimaM sapANDu pulAkatoyapratimaM kaPAttu' hati | tridoShajamAha - `sakShaudrasarpirharitAlavarNaM majjaprakASaM kuNapaM tridoShAt' ityAdi || 174-176 ||

gU0 - atha strIrogasaMKyA - atha strIroganAmAni procyante, kutaH ? pUrvaSAstrataH | teShAM vivaraNaM kriyate, aShTau ArtavadoShAste vAtAdiBirj~jeyAH, tathA raktapradaraM caturvidhaM udAhRutaM kathitaM triBirvAtAdyaiH sannipAtenaikaSca ||174-176 ||

pada: atha strIroganAmAni procyante pUrvaSAsrataH ||174|| aShTAvArtavadoShAH syurvAtapittakaPaistridhA | pUyABaM kuNapaM granthi kShINaM malasamaM tathA || 175 || tathA ca raktapradaraM caturvidhamudAhRutam | vAtapittakaPaistredhA caturthaM saMnipAtaH || 176 ||

vya_text: dI0 - yonau BavA rogA yonirogAH kathitAH | te duShTArtavavIryadoShAdinA janitAH | tathAhi - `viMSatirvyApado yonau nirdiShTA rogasaMgrahe | mithyAcAreNa tAH strINAM praduShTenArtavena ca | jAyante bIjadoShAcca daivAdvA SRuNu tAH pRuthak' iti | tatra viSeShalakShaNAttAsvAdau vAtalAmAha - vAtasya pRuthag vidhAnaM vAtavedanAprAdurBAvArthaM, yatra tantrAntare udAvRuttAvandhyAviplutAsu vAtAnubandhitvam | yaduktam - `catasRuShvapi cAdyAsu BavantyanilavedanAH' iti | evaM pittAnubandhinyo raktakShayA vaminI prasraMsinI putraGnI ceti catasraH pittalayA saha pa~jca paittalyaH | yaduktam-`catasRuShvapi cAdyAsu pittali~ggocCrayo Bavet' iti | evaM SleSmAnubandhinyo~atyAnandA karNinI acaraNA~aticaraNAScatasraH SleShmalayA saha pa~jca vij~jeyAH | yataH - `catasRuShvapi cAdyAsu SleShmali~ggocCryo Bavet' iti | evaM sannipAtajAH pa~jca vij~jeyAH | ShaNDI, aNDalI, vivRutA, sUcivakrA iti | catasraH sannipAtajayA saha pa~jca | yataH - `pa~jcAsAdhyA BavantIha yonayaH sarvadoShajAH' iti | evaM suSrutoktatvAcca doShAnubandhitvaM darSitam | atra vyastagaNanAsaMgrahatvena pRuthaksvarUpamadhunA vidhIyate | tadyathA - vAtAditi | vAtAnvitA vAtalA yonirBavati | tathAhi `vAtalA karkaSA stabdhA SUlanistodapIDitA' iti | pittAditi | pittAnvitA pittalA yoniH | yathA-`atyarthaM pittalA yonirdAhapAkajvarAnvitA' ityupalakShaNaM, tena nIlapItasitArtavA BavantItyavagantavyam | tathAca tantrAntare - `vyApallavaNakaTvamlakShArAdyaiH pittajA Bavet | dAhapAkajvaroShmArtA nIlapItasitAnvitA' iti | kaPAnvitA SleShmalA yoniH | taduktam - `SveShmalA picCilA yoni: kaNDUgrastAtiSItalA' iti | atiSItaletyupalakShaNam, tena savedanAdikatvamapi boddhavyam | yaduktaM tantrAntare - `kaPo~aBiShyandiBirvRuddho yoniM ceddUShayet striyAH | sa kuryAt picCilAM SItAM kaNDUgrastAM savedanAm? iti | sannipAtAditi militadoShatrayadUShitA yonirBavati | tathAhi - `sarvali~ggasamutthAnA yatra sA sannipAtajA' iti | raktAcceti raktadUShitA | yadyapi raktapittAnubandhinI yugapat paThitA tathApyatra raktasyAtisravaNAdraktajeti vyapadeSaH | tasmAdiha raktajA sraMsinI kathitetyaBiprAyaH | tadyathA - `prasraMsinI sraMsate tu kShoBitA duShprajAyinI' iti | lohitakShayato lohitakShayA kathitA | tathAhi - `sadAhaM kShIyate raktaM yasyAM sA lohitakShayA' iti | SuShkA ceti | SuShkA naShTArtavA kathitA | SuShkaM vandhyamArtavaM yasyA Bavati sA | ata eva tantrAntare vandhyAyoniH `vandhyA naShTArtavA j~jeyA' ityAdivacanAt | vAminI ceti | yA rajasA yutaM savAtaM bIjamudgiret sA vAminI | yathA - `atikAyagRuhItAyAstaruNyAstvaNDalI Bavet' iti |) sUcImuKIti atiSayaM sUcIvat saMkIrNamuKI - `sUcIvakrAtisaMvRutA' ityAdivacanAt | viplutA ceti | `viplutA nityavedanA' ityAdinA vAtajanitatodAdivedanAyuktetyarthaH | putraGnI ceti | tathAhi -
