`yasyAH punaruShNatIkShNopayogAdgarBiNyA mahati jAtasAre garBe puShpadarSanaM yonisrAvAt tasyA garBo vRuddhiM na prAgnoti, kAlAntaramupatiShThate, saspandanaSca Bavati tamupaviShTakamityAcakShate iti | nAgodara iti | nAgabandha iva sthitiryasya garBasya BavatItyeke | suSrute - tannAgodaralakShaNaM yathA - `SukraSoNitaM vAyunABipannamavakrAntajIvamAdhmAyatyudaraM tat kadAcit yadRucCayopaSAntaM naigameShApahRutamiti BAShante | tameva kadAcit pravilIyamAnaM nAgodaramityAhuH' | makkalla iti | makkallo raktamArutajaH SUlaviSeShaH | sa dvividho Bavati| eko garBAvasthAyAM, aparaH sUtikAvasthAyAm iti | tadyathA - `mAnasAgantuBirupatApaiH prapIDito yo garBaH kukShau vedanAM janayati sa garBamakkalla: | yatra prakupito vAyuH sUtayA rudhiramatyantaM saMrudhya hRucCirobastiSUlaM karoti sa prasUtimakkalla iti | tantrAntare yonisaMvaraNo~ayaM rogaviSeShaH kathitaH | yaduktam - `vAtalAnyannapAnAni grAmyadharmaM prajAgaram | atyarthaM sevamAnAyAM garBiNyAM yonimArgagaH || mAtariSvA prakupito yonidvArasya saMvRutim | kurute ruddhamArgatvAt punarantargato~anilaH || niruNaddhyASayadvAraM pIDayan garBa( nABi )saMsthitim || niruddhavacanocCvAso garBaScASu vipadyate || rujA saMruddhahRudayAM nASayatyASu garBiNIm | yonisaMvaraNaM vidyAdvyAdhimetaM sudAruNam' iti | mUDhagarBaSceti | mUDho vyAsaktagatiH pavano mUDhagarBaM karoti | yonijaTharAdiShu SUlaM karotItyaBiprAyaH | tathAhi - `mUDhaH karoti pavanaH Kalu mUDhagarBaM SUlaM ca yonijaTharAdiShu mUtrasa~ggam' ityAdi | viguNAnilayogAdadRuSyAsaMKyeyatvamAhureke, tasmAdatra eka eva paThitaH | tadyathA - `Bugno~anilena viguNena tataH sa garBaH saMKyAmatItya bahudhA samupaiti yonim' ityAdi | keShAMcinmate tatra vyavahArayogyA aShTau prakArAH kathitAH | tadyathA - `dvAraM nirudhya SirasA jaThareNa kaScit kaScicCarIraparivartitakubjadehaH | ekena kaScidaparastu Bujadvayena tiryaggato Bavati kaScidavA~gmuKo~anyaH || pArSvApravRuttagatireti tathaiva kaScidityaShTadhA gatiriyaM hyaparA caturdhA' iti | saMkIlakAdiBedena catuHprakArAn punarAhureke | tadyathA - `saMkIlakaH pratiKuraH pariGo~atha bIjasteShUrdhvabAhucaraNaiH SirasA ca yonau | sa~ggI ca yo Bavati kIlakavat sa kIlo dRuSyaiH KuraiH pratiKuraH sa hi kAyasa~ggI || gacCedBujadvayaSirAH sa ca bIjakAKyo yonau sthitaH sapariGa: pariGeNa tulyaH' iti | tantrAntare~api kIlakAdInAM lakShaNam | yathA - `UrdhvabAhuSiraHpAdai rundhyAdyonimuKaM tu yaH | pratikIlopamasthityA sa kIla iti saMj~jitaH | adhastAt pArSvato vApi tathaivAku~jcito~api vA | yo niHsRutya muKaM yonerj~jeyaH pratiKurastu saH || yonidvArAtta nurgacCedyaScaikA~gGriSiroBujaH | tamAhurbIjakaM nAma mUDhagarBacikitsakAH || yonimAvRutya yastiShThet pariGo gopuraM yathA | tathAntargarBamAyAntaM vidyAt pariGasaMj~jitam' iti | viShkamBa iti | viShkamBa iva viShkamBaH, mArgAvarodhAt tiShThati ityaBiprAyaH | sa tu vAtABipannagarBasya SoShaNAnmAtuH kukShiM na pUrayati, mandaM spandate ca | ata eva vRuddhakASyapena SuShkalakShaNaM vihitam | yathA - `garBanADyAstu vahanAdaplavatvAdrasasya ca | cireNApyAyate garBastathaivAkAlayojanAt | akukShipUraNo garBo mandaspandana eva ca' iti | mUDhagarBa iti | lInagarBaH kathitaH | tathAca suSrutaH - `vAtopadravagRuhItatvAt srotasAM vIyate garBaH so~atikAlamavatiShThamAno vyApadyate' iti | jarAyudoSha iti | vikRutajarAyuNA CAdanaM jarAyudoShaH | jarAyurgarBasyAveShTanarUpaScarmaviSeShaH | `jarAyuNA muKe cCanne' ityAdidarSanAt | arthAdgarBaSayyAyAM sthito yo bAlastasyopari veShTitolpavikAratvAjjarAyudoSha ityaBiprAyaH | garBaSayyA ca prasa~ggato yathA - `Sa~gKanAByAkRutiryonistryAvartA sA ca kIrtitA | tasyAstRutIye tvAvarte garBaSayyA pratiShThitA || yathA rohitamatsyasya muKaM Bavati rUpataH| tatsaMsthAnAM tathA rUpAM garBaSayyAM vidurbudhAH' iti | pAta iti | garBasya pAto~aShTamo BedaH | sa dvividhaH, ekaH srAvarUpaH, 'aparaH pAtarUpaH | tathAhi - `AcaturthAttato mAsAt prasavedgarBavidravaH | tataH sthi(ta)raSarIrasya pAtaH pa~jcamaShaShThayoH' iti| atiGanAvayavatvena viSeSheNa dravarUpatayA garBavidravaH kathyate | yaduktaM Boje - `AtRutIyAdyato mAsAt garBaH sravati SoNitam | UrdhvaM saMGAtaBUtastu garBaH patati yoShitAm' iti | viguNapavane tu saptamAdimAseShvapi pAta iti kecit | yataH -`garBo~aBiGAtaviShamASanapIDanAdyai: pakvaM drumAdiva PalaM patati kShaNena' iti || 180 || || 181 ||

gU0 - atha viSharogasaMKyAmAha -- sarvaM viShaM sthAvaraM, ja~ggamaM, kRutrimamiti trividhaM Bavati | teShAM trayANAM madhye navadhA sthAvaraM viShaM, tattu kAlakUTAdiBedairj~jeyam | ja~ggamaM tu bahudhA Bavati nidAne tu ShoDaSavidham | ja~ggamaM tattu latABuja~ggamAdikam | te~api caturvidhA Bavanti daMShTrAviMShAdiBedAt | kRutrimaM tu garadUShIBedataH dvividham | atha saptadhAtvAdiBedena viShaBedAnAha - saptadhAtuviShaM svarNAdisaptadhAtavaH evaM saptopadhAtujaM hIratAlAdijAtam | tathA upaviSheByaH ahiPenAdiByo jAtaM saptavidhaM Bavati ekaM duShTanIrajAtam | digdhajaM viShadagdhakANDajanyam | atha kapikacCvAdiBedena viShaBedamAha - ekA kapikacCUBavA tatra kaNDUrjAyate, ekA duShTanIraBavA sApi tadviShajanyA, ekA sUraNajanyA kaNDUH | tathA BallAtajaH SothaH eteShAmapi viShacikitsAsti tadarthaM viShAdhikAre gaNitAH || 196-202 ||

pada: sthAvaraM ja~ggamaM caiva kRutrimaM ca tridhA viSham ||196|| teShAM ca kAlakUTAdyairnavadhA sthAvaraM viSham | ja~ggamaM bahudhA proktaM tatra lUtA Buja~ggamA: ||197|| vRuScikA mUShikAH kITAH pratyekaM te caturvidhAH | 1 - vAgBaTasaMhitAyAM tu - `saMsargAdrasarudhirAdiBistathaiShAM doShAMstu kShayasamatAvivRuddhiBedaiH | AnantyaM taratamayogataSca yAtAn jAnIyAdavahitamAnaso yathAsvam ||' ityanantatvaM kathitam | vRuddhikShayasamarUpA doShANAM tridhA gatiH | daMShTrAviShaM naKaviShaM vAlaSRu~ggAsthiBistathA || 198 || mUtrAtpurIShAcCukrAcca dRuShTerniSvAsatastathA | lAlAyAH sparSatastadvattathA Sa~gkAviShaM matam || 199 || kRutrimaM dvividhaM proktaM garadUShIviBedataH | saptadhAtuviShaM j~jeyaM tathA saptopadhAtujam || 200 || tathaivopaviSheByaSca jAtaM saptavidhaM matam | duShTanIraviShaM caikaM tathaikaM digdhajaM viSham || 201 || kapikacCUBavA kaNDUrduShTanIraBavA tathA | tathA sUraNakaNDUSca Sotho BallAtajastathA || 202||
